english: Time alone is sufficient, the passage of time is sufficient; all this I will give you in return.

prakrit: चिन्धाĩ वेजयन्तीऒ पडाया केउणो धया हुडुमा,कुप्पासो कञ्चुयओ गिन्धुल्लो वारवाणो य
english: Chindhya is a vegetable, Padaya is someone's medicine, Huduma is something wormwood, Vindhulo is something of a dishwasher.

prakrit: जाण सिचयं कडिल्लं नियंसणं साहुली य परिहणयं,चेलं वासं वसणं च अंसुयं अम्बरं वत्थं
english: To know what is true, To control what is false, To manage what is real, To live what is not true, Is an inexhaustible boon.

prakrit: हेला ललियं लीला विब्भोओ विब्भमो विलासो य,ईहा इच्छा वञ्छा सद्धा कामो य आसंसा
english: Hela lily, Lila, vibhoma, vilaso yo, This is desire, this is true kama, and this is hope.

prakrit: बाला मूढा मन्दा अयाणुया बालिसा जडा मुक्खा,पामर-गहवइ-सेयाल-कासया दोणया हलिया
english: The child is dumb, The fire is dull, The hair is bristling, The farmer - the farmer - Has nothing to worry About, The plowman - Doesn't give a damn.

prakrit: पोरच्छो पिसुणो मच्छरी खलो मुहुमुहो य उप्फालो,कमलो कुसुमालो तक्करो य पाडच्चरो थेणो
english: Whether it's a man kissing, A mosquito hiding, A kiss on the mouth Or a spittle on the cheek, A lotus blooming, Or a wasp hiding in the mud?

prakrit: निद्धन्धसा निसंसा निच्चुड्डा निक्किवा अकरुणा य,रुन्दा पीणा थूला य मंसला पीवरा थोरा
english: Niddandhasa, nishamsa, nikkudda, akrunya, and raṇḍa are nothing but tears,"" Thula is nothing but a spittle in a man's mouth.

prakrit: सरिसो समो सरिच्छो सङ्कासो सच्छहो समाणो य,कढिणा य कक्कसा निट्ठुरा खरा खप्पुरा फरुसा
english: Well, you're right, It's only a matter of time before I see you again, Sweetheart. Once you've had your way, You'll find it hard to swallow.

prakrit: उत्ताणा उत्तणुया थिन्ना थड्डा य गव्विया दरिया,लोला लालस-लोलुय-उल्लेहडलम्पडा लुद्धा
english: Uttana uttanya thinna thadda ya gavya dariya, lola lalasa-loluy-ullehedlampada luddha

prakrit: सन्नं खिन्नं सुठियं उव्वायं नीसहं किलन्तं च,आइग्गं उव्विग्गं उच्चेयं वुन्नम उत्तत्थं
english: Slow and dragging, Wavy and limp, Now and then higher and higher, I mean higher.

prakrit: घडिअं विणिम्मियं विहियम आहियं विरइयं कयं जणियं,घत्तं कवलियम असियं विलुम्पियं वम्फियं खइयं
english: The clock is ticking, We are busy making friends, We have something to eat, We need something to drink, And the wind is blowing.

prakrit: सच्चविय-दिट्ठ-पुलइय-नियच्छियाइं निहालियत्थंमि,पव्वालियमाउम्बालियं च सलिलुच्छयं जाण
english: I know what is true - what is seen, what is false - What is pure - pure - and what is pure.

prakrit: रोमञ्चियम आरेइयम ऊसलियं पुलइयं च कण्ठइअं,पामुक्कं विच्छड्डियम अवहत्थियम उज्झियं चत्तं
english: Romanchium aureum, flute, and flute - these are the songs sung by the singers:"" ""Loud is the dismemberment of the pyre, Awhasty is the absence of fire.

prakrit: निट्ठुइयं खिरियं छिप्पियं च नीसन्दियं च पज्झरियं,वेयडियं पज्झुत्तं खचियं विच्छुरिययं जडियं
english: Silly girl, Silly boy, Stupid girl, We're stuck in the middle of nowhere.

prakrit: वोलीणं वुक्कन्तं अइच्छियं वोलियं अइक्कन्तं,पडिहत्थम उद्धुमायं अहिरेमइयं च अप्फुण्णं
english: Volume is inexhaustible until it fades, volume is infinite until it disappears, and form is impermanent until it is exhausted.

prakrit: हक्खुत्तं उच्चूढं उक्खित्तुप्पाडियाĩ उद्धरियं,कोवासियं वियसियं विणिद्दमुम्मिल्लमुप्फुल्लं
english: The hunter has raised the goose, The shepherd has lifted the buffalo, The cow is poisonous, The weeds are poisonous And the grass is worthless.

prakrit: बज्जरिय-सिद्ध-सूइय-उप्फालिय-पिसुणियाĩ साहिययं,पव्वायं वसुयायं सुसियं वायं मिलाणत्थे
english: Bajariya - siddha - sueya - upafaliya - pishuniyya: Friend, the good old days are spent in pleasantries.

prakrit: विच्छूढं उच्छित्तं पणुल्लियं पिल्लियं गलत्थिययं,पेढालनियक्कलवट्टुलाĩ परिमण्डलत्थंमि
english: I am the circumference of the circle, Like a scorpion climbing up and down And like a puppy falling down and down.

prakrit: टिविडिक्कियचिञ्चिल्लियचिञ्चइयपसाहियाĩ मण्डिययं,आलुङ्खियम आलिद्धं छिक्कं छित्तं परामुसियं
english: Twiggy girl, Slender girl, Sweet girl, It's the vermilion tree, Stupid tree, Hanging on by its branches And hiding under its branches.

prakrit: सामग्गियम अवयासियम आलिङ्गिययम उवऊढम ओसत्तं,अग्घइ छज्जइ रेहइ विरायए सोहए सहइ
english: Contentment, detachment, embrace, boundless excitement, The fire that burns brightly Resides happily ever after.

prakrit: सइ अविरयम अविरामं अणुवेलं सन्तयं सया निच्चं,छायं छउयं लयणं तणुयं तलिणं किसं खामं
english: Say, without ceasing, A long silence follows, A shadow hides, A bow stretches, A quiver quivers, And what's the harm in that?

prakrit: ललियं वग्गुं मञ्जुं मञ्जुलयं पेसलं कलं महुरं,कोमलयं सुहफंसं सोमालं पेलवं मउ य
english: A lotus is a clot, A rose is a garland, A jasmine is a pot, A beehive of nectar, A sweet lotus looks like a lotus.

prakrit: वियडं विउलं पिहुलं वित्थिन्नं वित्थयं उरु विसालं,खउरियम उच्चिंवलयं पट्टुहियं जाण कलुसजलं
english: The weeds are gone, The vines are scattered, The rivulets are wide, The straw is piled high, And the water in the pond Is stinking.

prakrit: गाढं बाढं बलियं धणियं दढमइसएण अच्चत्थं,सइदंसणं सइसुहं चिन्तादिट्ठंमि सइलम्भं
english: Deep is the fence, Strong is the bow; That is to say, I always think well of seeing the right one.

prakrit: अब्भासं अब्भन्नं आसन्नं सविहमन्तियं नियडं,कलियं विइयं विण्णायम अहिगयं बुज्झियं मुणियं
english: Love is bound to come, Friendship is destined to be made, Love is instilled in the mind, Wisdom is sown in the heart.

prakrit: सामलम असियं सामं कालं कसिणं सिएयरं कण्हं,सेयं सियं वलक्खं अवदायं पण्डु धवलं च
english: Samalam asiam Samayam kasam kaalam kaaman siyaram kaanum, seyam vaalakham avadayam pandu dhavalum.

prakrit: कविलं कविसं पिङ्गं पिसङ्गयं पिङ्गयं कडारं च,अरुणं सोणं रत्तं पाडलम आयम्बिरं तम्बं
english: A poem pines like a poem, A poem pierces like a pyre, And a cauldron makes a river flow like blood.

prakrit: फसलं सबलं सारं किम्मीरं चित्तलं च बोगिल्लं,इत्तो नामग्गामं गाहाचलणेसु चिन्तेमि
english: The harvest is plentiful, The fields are fragrant, And I think only of the roads leading to this village.

prakrit: अमरावई सुरपुरी तिविट्ठयं तह सुरालओ नाऒ,अलया कुबेरनयरी तित्थाहिवई जिणो अरहा
english: Amaravai, Surapuri, Twilight, That is the name of that melody. Alaya, the arrow of the Tithahivai, the daughter of Kubernayari, Deserves to live.

prakrit: कमला सिरी य लच्छी हेरम्बो गयमुहो गणाहिवई,रिक्खं उडु नक्खत्तं पुन्नयणा गुज्झया जक्खा
english: Kamala Siri ya lacchi herambo Gayamuhon ganahahivai, rudam udu naqqattam Punnyana gujjaaya jaqqa.

prakrit: नन्दणम अमरुज्जाणं कणयगिरी सुरगिरी सुमेरू य,फलिहगिरी कइलासो विहस्सई सुरगुरू धिसणो
english: Nandanam is nectar - like immortality, Kanyagiri is fragrant, Fruit - like jasmine - Only a wise master can heal.

prakrit: वासवसुओ जयन्तो पुलोमतणया सई य इन्दाणी,अइरावणो सुरगओ विज्जू सोयामणी य तडी
english: Vasavasu, Just like the waterfall in a pond, So does the river Indani, Only the heavenly heaven Vijju, Like the banks of the Soyamoni

prakrit: असणी वज्जं कुलिसं सुराउहं तियसचावम इन्दधणुं,अङ्गारओ य भोमो उसणो सुक्को दइच्चगुरू
english: As if it were an ox, The plowman's son, And the rice farmer's daughter - in - law's wife. A dry day for him Is the mark of a long life.

prakrit: भुयणं जयं च लोओ नरनाहो पत्थिवो निवो राया,मित्तो सही वयंसो मन्ती सइवो अमच्चो य
english: In the world, there is victory, In men, in women, And in death: Friend, we are right, In the mind, The soul is immortal.

prakrit: अन्तेवासी सीसो छलिओ छप्पण्णओ छइल्लो य,अड्ढा इब्भा धणिणो बन्धू सयणो सणाही य
english: The inmate is only a child, There are fifty-six other children: The youngest is a rich man's friend, The youngest a farmer's son.

prakrit: विप्पो दिओ दियाई य अङ्गया नन्दणा सुया तणया,अहियाओ कुलजाओ अणुजीवी सेवओ भिच्चो
english: Vippo diya ya angaya nandana suya thandaya, ahaya kulja, anujiva seva, bhikkho.

prakrit: नीसामन्ना गरुया अहमा इयरा य पायया नीया,रहयारा वड्ढइणो वच्छीवा वच्छवाला य
english: The poor man has grown old, His limbs are worn out, His feet are bare, He must be growing old, Like a wolf or a bear.

prakrit: सासाĩ छत्तधन्नाĩ गामणी भोइओ य गामवई,कुम्भारो य कुलालो गोवाला वल्लवा गोवा
english: Mother - in - law, Chhatradhanna, Gamani, Bhoi, Gamavai, Kumbharo, Kulalo, Gowala, Vallava Goans.

prakrit: आवणिया वाणियया मायङ्गा तह जनङ्गमा पाणा,पाउग्गिओ य सहिओ केवट्टो धीवरो दासो
english: The doer speaks in tongues, The traveler in love with women, The poor fellow favors the poor servant.

prakrit: बन्दीओ करमरिओ पुप्फच्चिणियाऒ पुप्फलाईओ,थम्भो थेवो विन्दू खव्वो हस्सो य वामणओ
english: Prisoners, blacksmiths, parrots, crickets, flies, The wasp, the crow, The crows, Laughs, etc., are the enemies of the people.

prakrit: रोयणिया लामाओ मूओ मूयल्लिओ य तुण्हिक्को,वयपरिणामो य जरा थेरी जरई गयवया य
english: Crying lamas, Foolish girl, You're the only one who knows how to behave When one has grown old.

prakrit: सोवणयं रइमन्दिरमाली तह माउया सही अत्ता,परयत्तो परछन्दो विक्खाओ विस्सुओ पयडो
english: Aunt, That's right, Mother - in - law! A shadow falls when you look at it, A whisper scares the scarecrow.

prakrit: नक्खा नहा कररुहा केसा चिहुरा सिरोरुहा वाला,चलणा कमा य पाया पओहरा तह थणा सिहिणा
english: Nakkha naha karruha ke kaisa chihura siroruha wala, chalna kama ya paaya pawra tha taisa tha breast sweet.

prakrit: पाणी हत्था य करा कत्ती चम्मम अइणं छवी खल्ला,दसणा रयणा दन्ता सिरोहरा कन्धरा गीवा
english: Pani hatha ya katti chammam ayyan chhamvi khalla, dasna rayana daanta, shirohra kaandhara geeva.

prakrit: वयणं मुहं च आणणमच्छी नयणं च लोयणं नित्तं,नासा घाणं घोणा सीसं सिरम उत्तमङ्गं च
english: There's nothing wrong with having a mouth and nose, Nothing wrong with looking at someone else's face, It's just the top of your head That stinks.

prakrit: भालम अलियं निडालं मंसू खड्डं च मासुरी कुच्चं,उयरं जढरं तुन्दं बप्फं बाही य नयणजलं
english: Bhalam alayam nidalam manasu kadam, masoori kuchcham, uttaram jadharam tum thudam buffum, Bahuda ya nayanam.

prakrit: इन्दियम अक्खं करणं छाया कन्ती छवी य लायन्नं,पिसियं सुल्लं मंसं कीलालां सोणियं रुहिरं
english: India, How can one hide one's shadow From another's gaze? It's my husband's slap in the face, My daughter - in - law's tears.

prakrit: खुङ्खुणओ नक्कसिरा वच्चं विट्ठा पुरीसमुच्चारो,लञ्छणम अङ्को चिन्धं घम्मजलं समजलं सेओ
english: Goose pimples, prickles, mustache marks, Sweat running down your cheeks Like sweat on a lotus.

prakrit: रमणं तियं नियम्बो कच्छा कञ्ची य मेहला रसणा,मुत्तावली य हारो मउली मउडो किरीडो य
english: Raman, you are innocent, Kaccha, Kanji, Mehla, Rasna, Muttawali, Haro, Mauli, Maudo, Kirido.

prakrit: नीरङ्गी अङ्गुट्ठी आहरणं भूसणं अलङ्कारो,विन्नासो विच्छित्ती कन्नायंसो य तलवत्तं
english: A limp thumb is an ornament to be worn when one is naked; Without it, one sighs, Like tears streaming down one's cheeks.

prakrit: तलिमं तप्पं सयणं च अङ्गराओ विलेवणं चच्चा,बाउल्ली पुत्तलिया विवणी तह आवणो हट्ठो
english: There's something wrong with the bottom of the jug, Like the solubility of one's fingers and toes, Like telling a story about a spiky girl.

prakrit: छत्ताइं आवत्ताĩ हंसयं नेउरं च मञ्जीरं,भद्दासणाĩ सीहासणाĩ उवहाणम ऊसीसं
english: Umbrellas are for women, hats are for men, bracelets are for husbands and wives, Bowls are for wives, Sweat is for wives and husbands for wives.

prakrit: वायायणो गवक्खो अद्दाओ दप्पणो य आयरिसो,वेरुलिओ वेडुज्जो कलहोयं रुप्पयं रययं
english: The wind blows the cowherd's ear, The buffalo licks its tail, And the ox screeches loudly As if it were a riot.

prakrit: सोवीरम आरनालं नेहो पिम्मं रसो य अणुराओ,पीढं विट्ठरम आसणम अहिरोहणिया य निस्सेणी
english: Forgive me, my lover, For not knowing what to wear When one is abroad But when one is absent As a guest In a most awkward position.

prakrit: सीरं हलं च नङ्गलम आउहम अत्थं च पहरणं होइ,माढी कवयम उरत्थयम असिमुट्ठी पालिया य छरू
english: The plow and the plow are useless, We must wear them all the time, For with a good poem and an accurate one The whole body Depends on us.

prakrit: चक्काĩ रहङ्गाइं सित्थं जीवा गुणो पडञ्चा य,तलिमं पट्ठं च तलं विवञ्चिया वल्लई वीणा
english: The virtues of the soul are manifested through the strings of the wheel, And the lute is played by the virtuoso strumming the strings.

prakrit: छीरं पयं च दुद्धं सिसिरं दहियं चिरड्ढिहिल्लं च,अज्जं सप्पिं च घयं अमयं च सुहा य पीऊसं
english: Cheese, milk, sesame seeds, curd, and bitter jasmine - Today, my dear, I wish you all the best.

prakrit: पारावओ कवोओ चडओ घरघण्टओ य कलविङ्को,चिल्ला घारी सउणी भिङ्घारी झिल्लिया चीरी
english: Paravo kavo, chadao ghar ghar ya kalavinko, cheela ghari sunni bhringari jhilliya cheeri.

prakrit: चक्कायओ रहङ्गो कयवाओ कुक्कुडो य तम्बसिहो,वरलाओ हंसीओ कणइल्लो पूसओ कीरो
english: Stay awake, Cry aloud, Roast a cucumber or a mango, Laugh a lot, And wipe away the pollen grains.

prakrit: गहरो वओ य गद्धो सारङ्गो चायओ य बप्पीहो,पिच्छाĩ पेहुणाइं नीडं निड्डं कुलायं च
english: Get out of the house, Donkey, Sarang, Tea or Bappi, The pursuer's wives need only sleep, Cool and cool.

prakrit: कोलो किडी वराहो भुल्लुङ्की य भसुया महासद्दा,कलहो बालो हत्थी करेणुया गयवहू करिणी
english: Kolo kidi varaho bhullunki ya bhasuya mahasadda, kalho baalo, hasthi karrunuya gayahu karruni.

prakrit: करिमयरो जलहत्थी कडुयाला कुम्बरा य लहुमच्छा,रिच्छो य अच्छहल्लो लङ्गूलं वालही छिप्पं
english: Aunt, A swarm of bees is hovering, A bitter gourd is on its way, And a scruffy langur is hiding under a bear's tail.

prakrit: तालूरो आवत्तो कुलीरकुरुविल्लया य कक्कडया,उग्गालो छिञ्छोली जम्बालो खञ्जणो पङ्को
english: The plowman's son has come, The coolie's daughter - in - law has arrived, And the cucumber is ripe for harvest.

prakrit: अयडो अडो य कूवो मेयलकन्ना य नम्मया रेवा,पल्ललमखायतल्लं पुक्खरिणी दीहिया सरसी
english: Ayado aado ya koovo meelakanna ya namaya rewa, Pallalamkhayathallam pukkarini dihya sarasi.

prakrit: रोहो वप्पो य तडो सालूरा दद्दुरा य मण्डुक्का,अरहट्ठो घडिजन्तं केयारो वप्पिणं वप्पो
english: Roho vappo ya tado salura dadura ya mandukka, arhattho gharat tho keirao vappon vapjo.

prakrit: नारुट्ठो कूसारो ओहारा कमढकच्छहा कुम्मा,गोयावरी य गोला डिण्डीरो पुप्फओ फेणो
english: Who is this go - between man and woman, That girl with big breasts Whose hair is tied in a bangle?

prakrit: उवलो गावो य सिला तूहं तित्थं नईऎ उत्तारो,तण्हा तिसा पिवासा गुहिरम अगाहं च गम्भीरं
english: You're not as tall as that girl in the village, Are you? Her breasts are as heavy as those in the cave.

prakrit: विरया तणुसरियाओ सेवालो सेवलं च जम्बालो,दोणीओ कुट्ठिम्बा कोटुम्भो जलकरप्फालो
english: Foolish women, Those who have nothing to lose Are like servants and servants: Both bow and arrow are like pots of water.

prakrit: जाला अच्चीऒ सिहाउ अद्धरा सत्ततन्तुणो जन्ना,पाया कडया साणू कन्तारं काणणं रन्नं
english: Jala achhiyo, Adhara sattantuno janna, paaya kadaya saanu kadaram Kaanem ran amok.

prakrit: सिङ्गं सिहरं कूडं साला साहा य साहुली डाला,कणई लयणी य लया कुसुमं पसवं पसूयं च
english: A lion sits on a lion's back, A tiger sits on its back, And a lioness stands by To guide the herd.

prakrit: कुसमरओ मयरन्दो रेणू पंसू रओ पराओ य,कोसी समी य सिम्बा दलं पलासं छयं पत्तं
english: Kusumrao, mayrando, rennu, pansu, rao, yaar, kosi samay, Simmba dalam, palasa, chhayam patam.

prakrit: छल्ली तया चुडुप्पं किसिलाइं पल्लवा पवाला य,तिङ्गिच्छी कमलरओ मलओ उज्जाणम आरामो
english: The peacock peeps at the parrot, The parrot licks at the flower petals, And the lotus shoots at its tip - Ujanam takes its rest.

prakrit: जलहरणम आलवालं तोमरिगुण्डी य मञ्जरीगुण्डी,वल्लीउ वल्लरीओ थवया गुच्छा गुलुच्छा य
english: Jalharanam aalavalam tomarigundi ya manjarigundi, valliyu vallariyo thavaya bunch guluchcha ya

prakrit: पत्तसमिद्धं पत्तलम आमेला चुब्भला य सेहरया,मल्लं माला दामं सद्दालं सिञ्जिरं कणिरं
english: A lotus is like a mango, Sweeter than nectar, Greener than jasmine, Brilliant than gold, Red as a garland And white as a bracelet.

prakrit: उम्मालो निम्मल्लं गुविलं कलिलं च वल्लरं गहणं,दावो दवो वणग्गी खन्धग्गी खोडपज्जाली
english: Women, swallow your jasmine, your kadila and your valour, For the day has already arrived When you will have to dig deep into the mud.

prakrit: वल्लरम अरन्नछित्तं गुट्ठं तह गोउलं वओ घोसो,छिप्पीरं च पलालं छलम अवएसो निहं च मिसं
english: The grasshopper is hiding in the thicket, The cow is hiding, The prawns are hiding, There's nothing left for him To do.

prakrit: थूणा दियली बेली टङ्कच्छिण्णं झसं च छिण्णयडं,पक्कं पिक्कं परिणयम इक्खू उच्छू य उच्छुवणं
english: The spittle is twisted around the girl's waist, The blush is scattered all over her face, And I am about to spit it out.

prakrit: वंसो वेणू वेलू य वञ्जुलो वेडसो य वाणीरो,तह जासुयणो य जवा फलिणी पियमा पियङ्गू य
english: A flute is like a flute, A bamboo shoot is like an ox, A cudgel is like the mouth of a snake, And like a fruit the lover drinks.

prakrit: सिन्दोलं खज्जूरं अम्बा मायन्दचूयसहयारा,तरवट्टो पामाडो अम्बिलिया चिञ्चिणी चिञ्चा
english: Sindolam khajooram amba, My mind is consumed by greed, Tarvatto pamado ambilia, Chinchini chincha

prakrit: कोहलिया कोहण्डी बरुओ सामुण्डुओ भमासो य,हयमारो कणवीरो सुलसा तह मञ्जुया तुलसी
english: Kohlia, kohundi, burru, samundu, bhamas, hayamaro, kanveero, sulsa, tulsi, manjua.

prakrit: मयणाही कत्थूरी मलयरुहं चन्दणं च इक्कङ्गं,घणसारो कप्पूरो आमोओ परिमलो गन्धो
english: The mango is fragrant, The scent of jasmine, red rose, and sandalwood are abundant.

prakrit: बिम्बवयं भल्लायं पायइया य वयली मयाली य,कण्टुल्लं कङ्कोडं मालूरं सिरिहलं बिल्लं
english: The image is of a good girl, Or of a lovely woman playing the flute: A cornucopia of thorns, A garland of garlands, A billow of reeds.

prakrit: अमिलाणो कोरण्टो नलयं लामञ्जयं उसीरं च,पुन्नाओ सुरवन्नी भिसिणी नलिणी कमलिणी य
english: Amilano koranto, nalayam, lamanjayam, usiram, punnao, suravanni, bisini, naalini, kamalini ya.

prakrit: सुरगोवो इन्दोवो कोलियया उन्ननाहम अक्कडया,मज्जारीऒ बिरालीऒ रासहो गद्दहो य खरो
english: Heaven or hell, Coolie or Unnaham, Stupid man or cat, Rasha or donkey, It's all right.

prakrit: भोओ फडो फणत्थे कुण्डुल्लुयकोसिया उलूया य,रोमन्थो उग्गालो उक्खा वसहा य वच्छाणा
english: Foolish girl, If you want to hang on to that coil Which is hanging loose From the rafters, Try hanging on to it While it's still warm.

prakrit: जन्तू सत्ता भूया य कोल्हुया जम्बुया य गोमाऊ,उडवो भावसगेहं गामहणं खेडयं पट्ठं
english: Whether the beast is in power, or whether the crow is dead, Or whether the cow has passed away, I will guide you with good sense Through the village and field.

prakrit: उद्दोली दुव्वाली य फम्फमा कोउया करीसग्गी,पत्थारी सत्थरओ लेढुक्को लेडुओ लेडू
english: Foolish dove or pheasant, Who would do such a thing? A plowman's son is a good man, And a woman's brother is a bad man.

prakrit: वारिज्जयं विवाहो तग्गयमणतप्परा य तल्लिच्छा,तुप्पाĩ कोउयाइं पईवपच्चत्थिणो वामा
english: Inheritance, marriage, etc., Or the desire to pursue them, Are the arrows that pierce a cowboy's tail.

prakrit: दलियं दारुं कट्ठं पत्थयणं सम्बलं च पाहिज्जं,भावो वत्थु पयत्थो खुज्जं कुडिया कुडिल्लं च
english: I need the porridge, The wood, the stone, and all the energy I can muster. It's like drinking wine in a jug of water.

prakrit: इन्दमहो कोमारो कोउयकुड्डाĩ कोउहल्लंमि,सुरही महू वसन्तो वासारत्तो य घणसमओ
english: The sun is hotter than the moon, I like cooler climes, Spring is sweeter than rain, And summer is a long time coming.

prakrit: माया कवडं कइयवमहा दिणा वासरा दिया दियहा,तुहिणं हिमं तुसारं घणनिवहो कालिया महिया
english: Maya kavadam kayivamah dina vaasara diya hai, tumhein usmein tumhara kaanivaahon kaaliya mahia.

prakrit: कुणवं सवं च मडयं पेयवणं पिउवणं मसाणं च,इङ्गालो अङ्गारो खायं तह खाइया परिहा
english: All flesh is drunk, all drink, all pleasure, But the yokel eats the coals, So eat the pariahs.

prakrit: ओवाइयं नवसियं विग्घा पच्चूहम अन्तराया य,वेयल्लम असामत्थं सुहमाणन्दो सुहॆल्ली य
english: Avvaiyam navasiyam viggha paacchuham antaraya ya, vaillam asamatham suhamanando suhelli ya.

prakrit: उग्घाओ आरम्भो सङ्खेवो सङ्गहो समासो य,निच्चं निययं सासयम अव्वाहारो अणालवओ
english: Begin early, gather often, make time for yourself, be patient, and never give up.

prakrit: वावडया अक्खणिया सन्ना गुत्तं च नामम अहिहाणं,अत्ती वियणा पीडा संरम्भो अमरिसो मन्नू
english: Vavadaya akanya, sanna guttam, namam, ahinahanam, ati viyyana paineda, sambharambho amariso mannu.

prakrit: मुल्लाĩ वेयणाइं पच्चग्गं अहिणवं च सज्जुक्कं,आवाओ पमुहमुरो हेला य अणायरो रीढा
english: The jasmine's bracelets are emerald green, Non - poisonous and fragrant. Come on, you fool, It's the anayor's spine that turns.

prakrit: जाण करम्बं तोत्तडिम अवरत्तयम अणुसयं च अणुतावं,कूरं चण्डं ओयणम ओणयम ओयत्तम ओमत्थं
english: To know what to do, To parrot what is inexhaustible, To embrace what is impermanent, Is the essence of love, Like the moon to summer, Like Onam to winter.

prakrit: थामं सारं च बलं थेवं लेसो लवो कला मत्ता,सारिच्छं समसीसी अदिही अरई य रणरणओ
english: Take all I have and gain all my strength, Art is but a matter of taste. For if you want to learn something You have to go the other way.

prakrit: इत्तॊप्पं एवप्पभिइ सम्भमो आयरो पयत्तो य,मन्तुं विलियं विप्पियम अच्छरियं अब्भुयं चुज्जं
english: Here and now, my dear, It's as if I had a pot of wine. I suppose you could taste it yourself, My dear.

prakrit: दीहत्तणम आयामो चवलं चडुलं च चञ्चलं तरलं,एमेय मुहा मुहिया केली नन्नं च परिहासो
english: Dehatnama ayamo chaval, chaadula, and panchalam talam, Aimee muha muhya, keli, nanna, are mere jokes.

prakrit: पलओ निहणं णासो पुण्णं सुकयं च भागहेयं च,हित्थं विलियं लज्जियम अत्थाणी तह सहा परिसा
english: Fallen, withered, and decrepit, The plowman's wife must suffer the same fate As the landowner's son.

prakrit: उन्नाहो उस्सेहो विक्खम्भो वित्थरो य परिणाहो,परिरम्भणम अवरुण्डणम आमोओ पहरिसो तोसो
english: Unnao, usse, vikram, vittha, yaar, parivartan, avarndanam, aamon, aapko, todo.

prakrit: नट्टं लासं तण्डवम अणुपुव्विपरम्पराउ परिवाडी,आरक्खो पुररक्खो अब्भासो गुणणिया जुग्गो
english: Nattam laasa, tandavam, anuvviparampara, pariwadi, arakkho, purrakakho, abhasa, gunya, juggo.

prakrit: अवहियम इक्कग्गमणं तद्दियसियदियसियाĩ अणुदियहं,ओलुग्गो नित्थामो दुज्जायं आवया वसणं
english: Ah! the absence of affection Is nothing like that of jealousy. Soon my wretched self will be gone, Like a poor man in distress.

prakrit: छुट्टं मडहं लहुयं रप्फा वम्मीयवामलूरा य,पायालं च रसायलम आउलम आहित्थम उप्पित्थं
english: Chutta mudham, raphasa vammiyavamloora, payalam rasayalam, aulam aahiththam uppitham.

prakrit: वेसाहो मन्थाणो सीलुट्टं चिब्भिडं च वालुङ्कं,कुम्भो कुडो य कलसो पिढरो ढमरो य कोलम्बो
english: Together we churn, We bend the sill and the buds of the hand, Together we knead, We knead and knead.

prakrit: कुडिलं वङ्कं भङ्गुरम आएसो सासणं च निद्देसो,खिप्पं तुरियं सिग्घं छेया पेरन्तअद्धन्ता
english: The cucumber is brittle, The bed is slippery, And the bed is sleepy. Khipum turiyum sigham Chheeya parentadhanta

prakrit: दीहं दीहरम आययम अहिउत्तो उज्जओ य उज्जुत्तो,कल्लो सत्थो य पडू हढो य मड्डा बलामोडी
english: The day is long, the morning is bright, the afternoon is long and the evening is long.

prakrit: पउणं निरायमुज्जुयमोलइयं परिहियं पिणद्धं च,अवरिल्लम उत्तरिज्जं उयट्ठी उच्चओ नीवी
english: Love is immutable, Love is pure, Friendship is boundless, The heights are bound to increase, And the low is bound to decrease.

prakrit: दुद्धियम अलाबु तुम्बं निबन्धणं कारणं नियाणं च,विलओ सूरत्थमणं सङ्खोहो सम्भमो तासो
english: Meditate, forgive and forgive, For if you refuse to meditate, There is no hope.

prakrit: उल्लूरियम उक्कडियं जङ्घियमोसिङ्घियं च अग्घायं,निव्विट्ठं उवहुत्तं तिरोहियं पिहियम अन्तरियं
english: Ulluriyam ukkadiyam, jhangiyam moshingyam, agghayam, nivvitham uthattam, tirohiyam, pyhiyam antaryam.

prakrit: उद्दालियम अच्छिन्नं अक्खित्तं अञ्छियं च कड्ढिययं,पन्नाडिययं परिहट्ठियं च ओसरियम ओसक्कं
english: Pride and dishonor, pride and vanity, Pride and deceit, Love and falsehood are the pleasures of love.

prakrit: उत्थल्लियम उच्छलियं पच्छाइयनूमियाĩ वइयाइं,निद्धाडिययं नीणियमोहीरन्तं च सीयन्तं
english: Rising, rising, and setting are the pleasures of the west. Standing, low and bowed, They last only for a moment.

prakrit: उन्नालियम उन्नामियम उवगयम उवसप्पियं च अल्लीणं,चुण्णइयं चुन्नाहयम उच्चिडिमं मुक्कम अज्जायं
english: Unnalayam unnamayam uvagayam uvasappiam illinam, chunnaiyam chunnahayam uchidimam mukkam ajjayam.

prakrit: उद्धङ्कयम ऊसवियं फुडियं फलियं च दलियम उद्दरियं,संवॆल्लियं मउलियं परिहायं दुब्बलं झीणं
english: Udhankayam usvayam, fudiyam phuliyam, daliyam udadariyam, samveliyam mauliyam pariahayam, dubbalaam jheenam.

prakrit: मुसुमूरिययं चुण्णियम उड्डिहिउक्खोडियाĩ उक्खित्तं,मुरुमुरियं तूरुइयं उन्नुइयं भुक्कियं जाण
english: Bees munch on raisins, bees fly, crickets fly, peacocks twitch, parrots trumpet, and gnats bark.

prakrit: अवचियम उच्चिणियत्थे तडियं तड्डविययं विरल्लिययं,उव्वमियं उग्गिलियं छुहाइयं भुक्खियं छायं
english: Undisturbed, When high and dry, When thin and sparse, When low and high, When shallow and shallow, When dark and shadowy.

prakrit: ताडियम आओडिययं निसुयं आयण्णियं निसामिययं,पज्जत्तं च पहुत्तं पणामियं दिण्णम उवणीयं
english: Tadyam aadiyam nisuyyam aayanam nisamiyyam, pajattam prabhutham panamiyam dinam unniyyam

prakrit: सन्दिद्धं संसइयं घोलियढुण्ढुल्लियाĩ भमियत्थे,सन्दिट्ठं अप्पाहियम उल्लं तित्तं च तण्णायं
english: Suspicious samsara is like a thicket of mud on the ground, Suspicion is like an endless stream of tears.

prakrit: रङ्खोलिरं पहोलिरम उव्वॆल्लं पसरियं पयल्लं च,सङ्कोडियं निउञ्चियम उत्तेजिययं च तोरवियं
english: Colourful jasmine, When it blooms, Spreads and blooms all over; Powdery neonchium, when it is hot, Stimulates the fire

prakrit: ऊसित्तं ओलित्तं पयारियं वञ्चियं च वेलवियं,उब्भालियम उप्पुणियं लहुइयमोहामियं तुलियं
english: Ustithum ulitum payarum venkium veluvium, Ubbhalium uppinium lehuimohamium tulium.

prakrit: पडिवन्नम अब्भुवगयं चिद्दवियं विउडियं विणासिययं,अइसइयं च विसेसियम उम्मुट्ठं पुञ्छियं फुसियं
english: Padi vannam abhuvagayam, chiddaviyam, vidyadam, vunasiyam, and speciality, ummutham, punshiyam, phusyam.

prakrit: विक्खित्तयं पइण्णं खित्तं निग्घत्तियं च आइद्धं,उग्गाहियम उच्चालियम अङ्कुसइयम अङ्कुसायारं
english: Stupid girl, The road is bumpy and slippery, The roads are bumpy, The paths are steep and the roads are impassable.

prakrit: आवडियं अब्भिडियं अहिड्डयं पीडियं परद्धं च,पम्हुट्ठं विम्हरियं चुलुचुलियं फन्दियं फुरियं
english: Awdium abvidium, Ahiddium pedium, Pardum pardum, Vimharium chulluchulium fundium furium.

prakrit: भट्ठं फिडियं चुक्कं परिहूयं अहिलियं पराहूयं,परिदेवियं विलवियं विरोलियं मन्थियं महियं
english: The hearth, the fiddle, the chokha, the plow, The field, the pastime, The goddess, the flower, The bee, the bee.

prakrit: धंसाडियं विमुक्कं गुण्डियम उद्धूलियं च धूसरियं,अक्कोसियं च सवियं भरिउल्लट्टं च वोसट्ठं
english: Dhansadiyam vimukkam, gundiyam, udhulyam, dhursariyam, akkosiyam, saviyam and bhariyullattam are all the same.

prakrit: ओइण्णं ओयरियं गविट्ठमण्णेसियं विमग्गिययं,रेयवियं सुण्णइयं निमियं निहियं च निक्खित्तं
english: There is the wind, The rain, The frost, The sleet, The fire, And the fire.

prakrit: भरियं लढियं सुमरियम ओसद्धं पाडियं निसुद्धं च,निसुढियम अक्कन्तभरोणयम उब्भडवेसं च उव्विव्वं
english: Full of struggle, Sumariyam was hot, dry and scorched was dry; without difficulty, unbroken and overflowing was the way to go.

prakrit: समुहागयमोसरियं बिन्दुइयं कणइयं कणायण्णं,विरमालियं विहीरियमोरालिययं च मालिययं
english: Group songs: Moseriam, bindu, kanyanam, viramalyam, vihiriamoraliam, maliyam

prakrit: तणुईकयम उल्लिहियं कप्परियं दारियं च निब्भिण्णं,उड्डीणं उप्पइयं जूरियम उत्तम्मियं नडियं
english: The grass is thin, The onions are white, The cucumbers are sweet, The rivers are salty, The flies are loud, The jewels are sharp, And the jasmine is brilliant.

prakrit: नीहरियं निग्गिण्णं बद्धं सन्दाणियं नियलियं च,ऊयट्ठं वासहयं महमहियं निग्गयामोयं
english: The blue sky is closed, The evening sky is blue, The sky is white, And with it the stream of glory.

prakrit: गुम्मइयं संमूढं फालियम ओरम्पियं च ओरत्तं,कज्जलइयं कसणियं कयपरिवेसं परिक्खित्तं
english: Gummaiyam samudra phalliyam orampiyyam orattam, Kajjalayam kasaniyam kayiparivesham parikshithyam.

prakrit: वेढिययं परियालियम उत्थरिओवग्गियाĩ अक्कन्तं,परिलीणं च निलीणं गन्धुग्गिरणंमि निम्महियं
english: A creeper is like a pearl That has been plucked out of the eaves And stuck in the mud, Like a fragrance of nectar That does not wither.

prakrit: निव्वडियं निम्मायं दाविययं दंसियं च दक्खवियं,तिक्खालियं निसायं पुलुट्ठयं पउलियं दड्ढं
english: The plowman's son is half dead, The hunter's daughter is two, And the hunter is one.

prakrit: पल्हत्थियम उल्लण्डियम उच्छुण्णं मद्दियं च निद्दलियं,पेसवियं पट्ठवियं घडियं लग्गं च संसत्तं
english: Palhatthiyam ullandiyam uchuna madhyamam niddalyam, peshaviyam pathaviyam ghariyam lagnam samstam.

prakrit: पयलाई ओहीरइ सक्कइ चयइ य तरेइ पारेइ,अव्वो छिन्नं वुच्छं सम्पइ इक्कक्कम अहिहाणं
english: A traveler knows what's best, chooses what he can afford, and only then can he see it all.

prakrit: करडा कुञ्जरगण्डा आलाणो हत्थिबन्धणक्खम्भो,करिबन्धणम अक्खायं उवओ वारणमओ दाणं
english: A black girdle is like a clenched fist, Like a hand binding a young stag; Like a knot fastened around its neck, Like the grain of a windmill.

prakrit: रवम अलसं कलमञ्जुलम ओरल्लिं महुरदीहरं जाण,सुइविरसं गद्दब्भं च गग्गरं कण्ठदरखलियं
english: Ravam, lazy kalamanjulam, Or know the pleasures of the scent of jasmine: I have seen the needle - poisoned jugular vein Through the girdle of my throat.

prakrit: ओऊलं पालम्बं हरियन्दणम अमरचन्दणं जाण,जच्चतुरङ्गं भायलम आयावलयं अरुणतावं
english: Oolum palamba, Hariyandanum, immortal sandalwood, Jachchaturanga, Bhailam, Ayavalum, Arunatavum.

prakrit: सीमन्तियं दुहावियम अपच्छिमं चरमम उद्धुरं उच्चं,वायणयं च पहेणयम इङ्गाली उच्छुगण्डीरी
english: Seemantiyam duhaviyam, abhinayaam, kshatramam, chaturama, utturaam, vayanayam, pahenayam, angali, uchchugandiri.

prakrit: विसढं विसमं वियलियम उच्चत्तं कत्तियासिणा सरओ,सिसिरो फग्गुणमाहो हेमन्तो पोसम अग्गसिरो
english: Wretched twigs, Valiyam heights, Scorched arrows, Sesame seeds, Fragrant jasmine, Possum of henna, Are the fires of fire.

prakrit: दुप्परियल्लम असक्कं पुक्काओ अलियपोरुसालावा,पञ्जायं पिण्डलइयमुऊ रिऊ चॊत्तओ तॊत्तो
english: Duparellam askum, Pukkam pukkao, Aliya porusalawa, Panjayam pindale, Muyu riyu, Chotto toto

prakrit: उवयारो पुप्फबली कुसुमङ्कालिञ्जणीऎ ताविच्छं,जवसं गवित्तम उलवी वीरणम ओलावओ सेणो
english: The plowman's wife is as eager to taste the fresh nectar As the plowwoman's husband.

prakrit: अग्गक्खन्धो अणियं पाडुच्ची तुरयदेहपिञ्जरणं,गरलं विसं विसाणं सिङ्गं रज्जू वरत्ता य
english: Fire, goose pimples, The twine of the trumpet, The tangle of trumpets, The bow of the flute, And the string of the lion.

prakrit: जगलं पिङ्गलसरओ बिण्ठसुरा पिट्ठखउरिया मइरा,हिज्जो कल्लं निव्वं पडलं काहिल्लिया तवओ
english: It's the peacock peeping out of the hole in the tree, Chasing after the stag, Who said:"" ""Tomorrow I'll fall at your feet.

prakrit: अणुरोहो दक्खिण्णं लग्गणओ पडिहुओ दरं अद्धं,हीरइ जं आणन्दे वत्थं तं पुण्णवत्तं ति
english: Face to face, Eyes to the right, Feet to the left, Heeray, whatever you bring, That's perfection.

prakrit: सञ्जवियं सङ्गोवियम अणुहूयं माणियं सुई वेओ,पासायस्सोवरि जा साला सा चन्दसालत्ति
english: Sanjevyam sangovyam anuhume maniam sui veyo, Pasayesvaram ja saala sa chandasaalatti.

prakrit: निब्भरम अइसयभरियं पत्थरियं अत्थुयं छडा छण्टा,रोसेणं उण्हिक्कं वयणं जं तं थुडङ्किययं
english: Nibhramam is a mass of stones strewn all over the place, Cutting through the gaps in the earth As if it were a bunch of reeds.

prakrit: साहिज्जं अत्थारो हिरिबेरो बालओ भिसी सारी,जं पिच्छइ तं वञ्छइ जो सो जम्पिच्छओ भणिओ
english: Friend, the earth trembles, The hair grows thin, And what's slippery is the desire of the hunter To say what he likes.

prakrit: पच्चाएसं दिट्ठन्तम ऒज्झरं निज्झरं दुहं दुक्खं,कयगण्ठि थणोवरि विरइयंसुयं गिन्धुयं जाण
english: I have never seen such a heavy weight, Such agonizing pain, So long have I known so many different kinds of swallows Apart from one breast.

prakrit: पडिमा पडिबिम्बं कज्जवो कयवरो वियाणम उल्लोवो,उभओ वासुत्थल्लणम उच्चत्तवरत्तयं भणियं
english: Whether it's mud on the ground or bamboo shoots on the wind, I speak from a high position.

prakrit: रिक्कं रित्तं पत्ताĩ भाइणाइं सिरिद्दहो पविया,मुहविक्कोणो छिच्चॊल्लउत्ति जो निन्दणत्थंमि
english: Wait a moment, my brothers and sisters,"" said the doe, squeezing the tip of my lip As if to condemn it.

prakrit: दिट्ठं विहावियं मिण्ढियाऒ अविलाऒ सेरिही महिसी,परिपासउत्ति छॆत्ते जो पुरिसो सुयइ राईए
english: When he sees you He can only smile, And when he sees a mermaid run up to you He falls asleep on his back.

prakrit: घुसिणं कुङ्कुमम उक्का चुडुली खाणी खणी कुढं कूवं,उच्छण्टउत्ति तुरिययरचोरियाहत्थवावारो
english: Jump into the kumkum, peep into the pit filled with gooseflesh, Jump out of the hole in the mud, Stir in the trumpetflowers of the hunter's bow.

prakrit: बद्धं सङ्गिल्लं तणुरुहाĩ रोमाĩ चित्तओ दीवी,हुत्तवयं जस्सन्ते सुव्वइ तं तस्स सुमुहत्ति
english: A lamp brightens the mood of a woman in love, Like the rays of the sun That illuminate her whole being.

prakrit: कूलं तीरम असोओ कङ्कॆल्ली रञ्जणो अलिञ्जरओ,खुन्नं चमढियमूढा परिणीया मिहुणयं जुयलं
english: Cool arrows, such as these, Are a repugnant ornament to a skeleton."" The pariah's wife has gambled away her young skin.

prakrit: उय पिच्छ धरइ जीवइ दुच्चं दूअत्तणं दिसा आसा,सङ्खायं थीणं सन्दणो रहो सारही सूओ
english: Life goes on, The wicked messenger returns, The good days are over, The days are numbered And the nights are long.

prakrit: रोसाणियं मसिणियं वणं पहारो पयामम अणुपुव्वं,लञ्चा उक्कोडा सारहं महुं बाहिरं बाहिं
english: Rossaniyam, masiniyam, vaanam, paadamam, anupuvvam, lancha, ukkoda, sarum, beehive, are outside the house.

prakrit: वुत्थो वसिओ वत्थी अवाणम आहोरणो गयारोहो,खत्तं खन्नं साहू सुयणो खेयालुओ असहो
english: A man who lives alone Can eat only grass, And a man who sleeps alone Can drink only wine.

prakrit: लहुदारु किलिञ्चं मन्थरा कुसुम्भी तुरङ्गिया वडवा,सङ्खो कम्बू गेयं गन्धव्वं बन्धणं बिण्टं
english: The plowman's son asks how the cotton grows, And the farmer's daughter says:"" ""It grows on the lotus."" ""The bamboo shoots are fragrant and need no binding.

prakrit: सीमा मेरा वासं वुट्ठी हालाहलो य बम्भणिया,कारू सिप्पी करहो कमेलओ रोहिओ रॊज्झो
english: The limit of my existence Is only the plowman's yard, Or the farmer's field, Or is it the blacksmith's rose?

prakrit: केऊरम अङ्गयं विड्डुमं पवालं कणेट्ठिया गुञ्जा,झाडं कुडङ्गओ कलुसम आविलं सित्थयं मयणं
english: Whose limbs are twisted, Whose feet are bristling with gooseflesh, And whose limbs are bowed by the axe of pride.

prakrit: बुक्का मुट्ठी सग्गहम उवरत्तं लॊट्ठयं सुवन्तं च,परतीरं पारं अट्ठयक्कलिं जाण कडिखम्भं
english: A handful of raisins, A large bunch of lotuses, A good pair of sesame seeds, And on the other hand, A bunch of acacia flowers.

prakrit: लोहं कालायसम उम्मुयं अलायं विसेसओ तिलओ,कोणो लउडो जउणा कालिन्दी गज्जिअं थणियं
english: Lohe kaalayasam ummuyum alayum bhesao tilao, kaun ka ladoo jawan kaalindi gajjiyan breastiyum.

prakrit: दुव्वा हरियाली कॊट्ठओ कुसूलो कडुच्छुओ दव्वी,भे तुब्भे कुल्लडयं कोडयम अप्पुल्लयं निययं
english: Dua hariyali kotha, kusula, kaduchchu, davvi, bhe tubhe kulladayam, kodayam, appullayam niyayam.

prakrit: डोला पिङ्खा मायणिहया झला पाउसागमो झञ्झा,दुट्ठो कली पयङ्गो सलहो कलहाइयं रडियं
english: A flock of peacocks Jumps from the sky In the cool of the rain, Seems to scream loudly As if it were a festival.

prakrit: साहरियं साहट्ठियम अंसो भाओ पिहाणिया मण्डी,तारं दित्तं वेसो नेवत्थं मक्खियं तुप्पं
english: Sahryam sahityam anso bhao, Pahaniya mandi, star giveaway veso Never mind finding a beehive

prakrit: जाण कडक्खम अवङ्गं कलहं परिवारम उब्भयं उद्धं,सायं पओसम उत्तप्पम उद्धयं दूसहं तिव्वं
english: When there is a quarrel between one's relatives and another, Fear creeps in, And when there is an evening flare-up, It hurts.

prakrit: दाराĩ दुवाराइं नेलच्छो पण्डओ जडं सिसिरं,कोडी अग्गं पङ्गू पङ्गुलओ तण्णओ वच्छो
english: Dara, you're not going to touch my husband, You're just going to smear his body all over with sesame seeds.

prakrit: छाया छाही पाहुडम उवायणं सारिया सालहिया य,भन्दं सिवं सयज्झो समोसिओ छिम्पओ उञ्छो
english: A shadow casts a shadow, A lotus opens, And a lotus grows on the face Of the God of Love.

prakrit: सालो पायारो मज्जिया रसालाउ सॊज्झओ रयओ,हरियं सद्दलम अङ्को उच्छङ्गो अक्खयं अणहं
english: Salo payaro, marjoram, pomegranate, freshly squeezed juice, Rayo, Hariyam, Saddalam, Angkor, Is an inexhaustible burden.

prakrit: मणयं ईसि कुविन्दो य तन्तुवाओ दुरोयरं जूयं,पज्जा अहियारो अइरम अङ्गणं मज्जियं ण्हायं
english: Believe me, you crook or weasel, Gambling far and wide Is nothing like the marjoram in a deserted courtyard.

prakrit: आसत्थो वीसन्तो वज्झो वद्धो पयट्टयं चलियं,करणी रूवं चलियं वइकलियं परिसरो पासा
english: From now on I will walk a little more slowly,"" he said, ""But if you want to walk slowly, you must walk slowly.

prakrit: आरद्धं आढत्तं निहयं निक्खयम अवेसिणो फलिहा,फरिसो फंसो तुमुलं मुहुलरवो पायसो खीरी
english: Prayer is nothing but the fruit of ineptitude, But when you have it all figured out, It's just a matter of finding the right one for you.

prakrit: उम्मलणं उच्चलणं इहरा अन्नह सहासओ सब्भो,चित्तं माणसम अक्खो बहेडओ सङ्गमो मेलो
english: Friendship is supreme only when it is warmed up, When it is drunk, When one's mind is open to the human eye, And when one is absent One's association is dead.

prakrit: समओ मयं विरायं विलीणम उप्पाहलं च उक्कण्ठा,सञ्चारी दूई सालिरक्खिया कलम अगोवित्ति
english: Time has parted me, The churning fire has boiled over, The traveler's pen has spun like a two-edged arrow.

prakrit: रुग्गं भग्गं मङ्गुलम असुन्दरं वेवियं च थरहरियं,पप्फोडियं च पक्खोडियं विसट्टं विहडियत्थे
english: Sickness has broken out, Mangulam is unsightly, Veyviam is shivering, Papphodium is ripe, Diffusion is everywhere.

prakrit: परिहत्थो दच्छो कोवणो असहणो पईवओ दीवो,इय एवं रेसणिया करोडिया चन्दिमा जुण्हा
english: When you look at someone else's face You cannot help but notice that the lamp is on, Like the rays of the crescent moon.

prakrit: पाडिक्कं पत्तेयं उम्बरओ देहली विही दिव्वं,तन्तू गुणो दुगञ्छा गरिहा खलियं पडिप्फलियं
english: Padikkam leaf is like nectar in Delhi, The quality of the fibre Is inferior to that of the latex.

prakrit: आसारो रयवुट्ठी पम्हलयं रोमसं जओ वेओ,कीस किणो हलहलओ तरा वियट्ठं विसंवइयं
english: As the fire burns, So does the flame burn, Why is the fire burning so relentlessly?

prakrit: सम्बाहं सङ्किण्णं वलग्गम आरूढम अहियम अइरित्तं,आहूओ वाहित्तो वियत्थणं नियगुणसलाहा
english: Come on, you fool, I've got to pick up your skirt. Stop dragging it around. It's just the way things are.

prakrit: जाण सवायं डॊम्बं सॊण्डं मज्जवम अयण्डम अणवसरं,सरडं च कङ्कलासं छणं महं लॊद्धयं वाहं
english: Knowing how to bend a bow, To bend a sling, To uncurl a noose, To cut through a skeleton Like a lizard, I carry a load.

prakrit: लक्खं विजायम इङ्गियम आयारो अह इमो इमा अज्जा,थाहो थग्घो तोणो तोणीरो कण्डुओ गुलिओ
english: Laakham vijayam ingeyam ayyaron ah, imo ima ajja, toh thaggho toh tuneeron tendu gulio.

prakrit: कण्ठो गलओ अवडू कियाडिया झम्पणीउ पम्हाइं,गुप्फा खुलुहा जङ्घा टङ्का गण्डा कवोला य
english: Goose pimples, Swirls of gooseflesh running down your cheeks, Goofy mouth, Jump open thighs, Make your face look like a rhinoceros!

prakrit: रसणा जीहा सवणा कन्ना वच्छं उरं भुया बाहू,भुमया भमुहा कक्खा भुयमूलं जण्हुया जाणू
english: Rasa jeeha, savana kanna bachchhon aur humari bhaiya bahu, bhumiya humari kakha, bhuyyamul janmu yaar.

prakrit: कन्ना कुमरी धूया दुहिया बहिणी ससा पिया जणओ,माया जणणी सुण्हा पुत्तवहू देयरो दियरो
english: Kanna, kumari, dhanya, dooya, sister - in - law, pyaasa, jana, maya, janmani, sunnah, putru, detractors.

prakrit: माउच्छा माउसिया अत्ता सासू सहोयरो भाया,मल्लाणी मामी पुप्फिया पिउच्छा पई भत्ता
english: Aunt, Mother - in - law is a friend of mine. Aunt Puffy's allowance is pecuniary.

prakrit: रम्भा कयली सिन्दी खज्जूरी सत्तला य नोमाली,गुम्मो जाली बोरी कक्कन्धू केसरो बउलो
english: Rambha kayali, Sindhi khajuri, Sattala ya nomali, Gummo jali bori, Kakandhu kesaro boulo.

prakrit: पलही ववणं तूलो रूवो दब्भो कुसो जवो गज्जो,थम्बा सढा कलम्बो नीवो गोल्हाफलं बिम्बं
english: To plant a sapling Is like rubbing a cotton ball, To crush a cluster of acacia berries, Like picking a bunch of watermelon.

prakrit: अइमुत्तो माहविया लवओ गुन्दो पियङ्गुणो कङ्गू,कलमो साली य बिसं मुणालम उल्लूढम अङ्कुरियं
english: It's the nectar of bees that makes the flowers bloom, The kadamba flowers blossom, The lotus flowers sprout, And the flowers wither.

prakrit: नग्गोहं वडरुक्खं सिग्गुं सोहञ्जणं तलं तालं,चारं पियालम अजुयलवन्नं सत्तच्छयं जाण
english: I know the wood - apple tree, The bottom of the pond, The pleasures of love, All four payalams, All seven shades of blue.

prakrit: बीययम असणं पिप्पलम आसत्थं तिण्डुयं च टिम्बरुयं,रायञ्छुयं च वेडिसमलम्बुसं बोडघेरं च
english: To have seeds is like having a peacock's tail, To have a swarm of locusts And grasshoppers on one's back, Like the nectar of a scorpion on another's body.

prakrit: खलिणं कवियं मइलं मलीमसं सीहरा जलतुसारा,थाणू खण्णुयम अलया कुरला दन्तच्छओ उट्ठो
english: Calm down, Poet, Soak up the stink of stool, Wet and watery, Loose the girdle of teeth That curl beneath your chin.

prakrit: सीलं पयई तत्तं परमत्थं गोउरं पओली य,रयणी हत्थो भीओ हित्थो साहीणम अप्पवसं
english: The cow has reached her climax, The cowherd has reached his feet, And the hunter's wife has put her hands through his bows.

prakrit: दीणो वरओ विड्ढिरम आडोवो रग्गयं च नवरङ्गं,लण्हं मसिणं ठाणं ओवासो गोयरो विसओ
english: The poor bridegroom is a fool, The plowman is a coward, The weeds are white, The rug is white, And the navaranga is white.

prakrit: आरोवियं विलइयं धोयं विच्छोलियं दसा वत्था,सङ्कू कीलो रुण्टियम अलिविरुयं सीरिओ भिन्नो
english: Auroviam vilayam, Dicholiyam dasa vatha, Sanku keelon, Runtiam aliviram, Siriyom different

prakrit: असमञ्जसम अनिबद्धं पडिसिद्धो वारिओ चरो पणिही,निहसो कसो समन्ता सव्वत्तो चारओ कारा
english: The incompatible is bound to fall, The crooks fall in love, How can one disbelieve That all four are alike?

prakrit: विहुलं विसण्ठुलं जाण सामरिं सिम्बलिं थलिं भूमिं,घरवाडयं परोहडम आयइमज्जन्तकालं च
english: Destroyed, destroyed, destroyed and reduced to ashes the earth, The walls of the house, The streets above, For ever and ever.

prakrit: वालिययं परियत्तियम ऊढिययं पाउयं मियं तुच्छं,हुण्डी घडा पउट्ठो कलाइया गण्डओ खग्गो
english: Valiyam pariyattam udhiyam, paavayam meem trivial, Hundi pot, Puttatho kalaiya, Gando khaggo.

prakrit: सण्डं वणं मुयङ्गो मुरओ य विवज्जओ विवज्जासो,पमहा गणा कलावो तिउडो वत्थं दुगुल्लं च
english: A forest in the evening Makes one wretch, Or a forest in ruin, Or an orchard in ruin. But to count one's plunder Is to mention two.

prakrit: महुरं साउं वारी करिधरणट्ठाणम अग्गला फलिहो,विसयं फुडं तरन्तं परिप्पवन्तं हियं नीयं
english: Fruit of the fire, Like a bee That swims by itself, Grows brightly. So do not worry about the ripe fruit As long as it floats by itself.

prakrit: लक्खारुणियं पल्लवियम आवियं पोइयं घढं थूहं,रूढं पउणं जामो पहरो बहुलो कसणपक्खो
english: Lakharunyam, Pallaviyam, Vayam, Poyyam, Gharam, Tharum, Pavanam, Jamon, Paharom, Bahulom, Kasnapakshakhom.

prakrit: पडिभेओ पच्चारणम आसन्दी पीढिया रणी सद्दो,सयडो गन्ती तंसं तिरिच्छम असिधेणुया छुरिया
english: The poor girl has passed from generation to generation, The hunter has turned his back on her, Counting the days.

prakrit: छोहो विक्खेवो हिययम आसओ कन्दरो य कप्पाडो,कूणियम अद्धनिमीलियम अच्छायन्तं निसायन्तं
english: Touch, pierce, touch, weep, or muddle, The nail is half empty, For as long as you touch it, It lasts forever.

prakrit: संमद्दो सङ्घट्टो रासो हल्लीसओ खमं उचियं,गुज्झं रहस्समासा मणोरहो कोसयं चसयं
english: There's always a struggle, there's a quarrel, There are quarrels, But when it's over, It's smooth sailing, The humours are mysterious And someone has to steal it.

prakrit: रङ्गो पिच्छाभूमी दरी गुहा चूडओ वलयबाहू,खञ्जो खोडो य नडो कुसीलवो नालिया घडिया
english: A field is a sliver of mud, A valley is a heap of reeds, A canal is a jug of mud Or an empty stream Is a clogged drain.

prakrit: पासाओ हम्मियमणुयघण्टिया किङ्किणी कणी फुरणं,पोओ वहणं सबरा य किराया मालई जाई
english: Come on, you fool, Can't you hear the clock ticking? It's about to strike early? The fare will be dearer if you carry it with you.

prakrit: जॆत्ति पयपूरणे विम्हयंमि ही विलवियंमि अवि हाहा,अन्तो मज्झे पुरओ य अग्गओ मग्गओ पच्छा
english: As long as I am filled with purity I will be wealthy, haha. Either the fire consumes me or the road is impassable.

prakrit: खेयाइसु अव्वो हन्दि उत्ति आमन्तणंमि देसद्दो,इर तच्छीले इल्लो इत्तो आलो य मउयत्थे
english: Come, let me give you a handshake And invite me over. There's nothing wrong with that - It just happened to come from my heart.

prakrit: विक्कमकालस्स गए अउणत्तीसुत्तरे सहस्संमि,मालवनरिन्दधाडीऎ लूडिए मन्नखेडंमि
english: The summer has passed, The rainy season is over, The plowman's wife has plundered the fields of mangoes.

prakrit: धारानयरीऎ परिट्ठिएण मग्गे ठियाऎ अणवज्जे,कज्जे कणिट्ठबहिणीऎ सुन्दरीनामधिज्जाए
english: If you want to enjoy the beauty of the river, Stay undisturbed, Then why not decorate your house with beautiful flowers?

prakrit: कइणो अन्ध जण किवा कुसल त्ति पयाणम अन्तिमा वन्ना,नामंमि जस्स कमसो तेणेसा विरइया देसी
english: Somebody is blind, Some are clever, And the last one has passed away. I will not go abroad Unless I have accomplished something.

prakrit: कव्वेसु जे रसड्ढा सद्दा बहुसो कईहि बज्झन्ति,ते इत्थ मए रइया रमन्तु हियए सहिययाणं
english: Poets, The rasa that is most often recited is so full of rhymes That I have to endure it all.

prakrit: पाइयलच्छी नाममाला समत्ता
english: Payalchhi Namamala Samatta

prakrit: सुहसामन्नपइन्नासमयसमारद्धलोयकम्मस्स,अमरवइवयणधरिओ परिकुडिलो कुन्तलकलावो
english: Blessed is the penitent who in due course of time renounces modesty."" - Parikudilo Kuntalakalavo, The God of Immortal Love

prakrit: कन्नासन्ने सोहइ जस्स अवत्थाणपत्थणत्थंव,चित्तब्भन्तररुद्धप्पवेसकन्दप्पदूउव्व
english: The pleasure of dancing arises from the moment one steps onto the surface of the earth, from the concentration of one's thoughts into another.

prakrit: सोहइ जस्स सुसङ्गयउभयंसलुलन्तकुन्तलकलावा,मुत्ती सुवन्नवन्ना सकज्जलग्गव्व दीवसिहा
english: Blessed is the pearl of sweetwood, Whose blossom is like the lotus of a goodly bunch of flowers.

prakrit: जस्स पणामा पावइ पलयं पउरोपि विग्घसङ्घाओ,तस्स रिसहस्स पढमं नमामि पयपङ्कयं पयओ
english: As soon as the panama opens I will gather the remains of my husband's body,"" he said, ""Then with a sigh I will recite the Preamble.

prakrit: अजियाइणो जिणिन्दे वन्दे जम्मंमि जेसिममरिन्दा,रागाइणो वि सत्तू पञ्चत्तं पाविया समयं
english: Ajjaiya, Jinainde, Vande Jammami, Jasima Marinda, Ragaina, Vi Sattu, Panchattam, Paviya Samay

prakrit: जम्मणसमयाणन्तरसुमेरुसिहराभिसेयसमयम्मि,सक्कन्दणकयकुवियप्पन्नासणे कयपयत्तस्स
english: When the moon is full, When the clouds gather, And when the sun rises, What do you think of when you kiss her on the mouth?

prakrit: रागाइवइरिसेणव्व जस्स दट्ठुं अणन्नसामत्थं,थरहरिया अच्चत्थं ससिलोच्चयसायरा वसुहा
english: To hear a melody is to see the opposite, to tremble it is to hear something that is not quite right.

prakrit: निम्मलकमनहनियरो पडिबिम्बियपणयतिहुअणो जस्स,उव्वहइ जायगव्वो केवलनाणस्स समसीसिं
english: Like a lotus in your heart, Like a drop of nectar in your eye, You can only cause pain wherever you go.

prakrit: जस्स य पणाममेत्ता निम्मलकमणक्खपडियपडिबिम्बा,एक्कारसगुणमुवलब्भ अप्पयं हरिसिया तियसा
english: Just look at your husband's face, Which is smeared with red ghee, Like a mark on the cheek of a good man.

prakrit: तं वन्दे जिणयन्दं देविन्दनरिन्दविन्दवन्दिययं,सिद्धत्थनरिन्दसुअं चरिमं चरिमं गइं पत्तं
english: Vande Jnanendam, Devindarindambindavandiyam, Siddhathnarindasa charima, charima gayam paatha.

prakrit: दुज्जयअणङ्गमायङ्गभङ्गसारङ्गपुङ्गवसरिच्छे,सासयसिवसुहसहिए सिद्धे सिरसा नमंसामि ११
english: I bow before you, O wicked one, Through the twists and turns of my limbs And the joys of my life. 11

prakrit: दुद्धंसधन्तविद्धंसधीरसिद्धन्तदेसए धीरे,पञ्चविहायाररए सिरसा वन्दामि आयरिए
english: Slow down, sweetwood tree, Steady tree, Come, my lord, With five directions I will greet you.

prakrit: विसयसुहनिप्पिवासे संसारच्छेयकरणतल्लिच्छे,वन्दामि उवज्झाए सुत्तत्थविसारए सययं
english: By living in ecstasy I detach myself from the cycle of rebirth, By embracing it all the time With my round breasts.

prakrit: पञ्चमहव्वयदुव्वहपव्वयउव्वहणपच्चले सिरसा,घरवासपासमुक्के साहू सव्वे नमंसामि
english: On the auspicious occasion of Panchamahavayudhu, I bow to you all, my dear, all the Sahus who live near my house.

prakrit: जीए कमकमलं पाविऊण पाविन्ति पाणिणो परमं,नाणं अन्नाणा वि हु सा जयइ सरस्सई देवी
english: To live on less than one lotus Is to attain the supreme state of purity, But to give birth on nothing Is to conquer the Sarasvai goddess.

prakrit: जाण पसाएण पुण मएवि जडबुद्धिणा कहाकरणे,लीलाए पयट्टिज्जइ,विसेसओ ते गुरू वन्दे
english: One who knows what is good for one's self, speaks with understanding, acts in a playful manner, etc., is a great teacher.

prakrit: इय पुज्जपणइकरणप्पणासियासेसविग्घसङ्घाओ,वोच्छं संवेगकरिं कहं तु सुरसुन्दरिं नाम
english: Tell me, dear girl, How come you sound so confident When you ask me what my favorite name is?

prakrit: अन्नं च तस्स कीरइ पढमं चिय पत्थणा खलजणस्स,बीहेइ कविजणो जस्स मूसओ इव बिडालस्स
english: What good is food to him, What bad is a stone to a reader of his, And what a wretched man a poet is to a man like Moses.

prakrit: अहवा सहावउच्चिय दोसग्गहणम्मि वावडमणस्स,अब्भत्थणासएहि वि न खलस्स खलत्तणं गलइ
english: Ahava sahava ̄ ya dosa ̄ gan ̣ ami va ̄ da-manasa, Even if you neglect it, You cannot harm him.

prakrit: कुडिलत्तणं न उज्झइ परिच्छिद्दगवेसओ य दोजीहो,पत्थिज्जन्तो वि कवीहिं दुज्जणो सप्पसारिच्छो
english: It does not matter whether you are a poor traveler or a poor one; poets, even when they are poor, help those who are poor.

prakrit: अब्भत्थिओ वि वङ्को कलुसियहियओ सुवित्तपरिहीणो,चन्दोव्व दुज्जणो इह दोसासङ्गे पयासेइ
english: The moon is wicked, It fills the world with wicked people, It destroys good and evil.

prakrit: ललिए व निट्ठुरे वा कव्वे दोसो खलेहिं घेत्तव्वो,उट्ठमुहाओ अहवा नीहरइ न जीरयं कहवि
english: Whether he sighs or groans Or whether he mutters a curse Goes astray. But do not be alarmed When he rises And falls.

prakrit: दुज्जणसहाए पडियं निम्मलकव्वं पि लहइ न पइट्ठं,जलबिन्दुव्व सुतत्ते आयसभाणम्मि पक्खित्तो
english: The plowman's daughter - in - law did not turn her back on him Even though she was wearing a blue salve. The water droplet had drifted from her breast While she slept.

prakrit: आसज्ज दुज्जणं कविजणस्स अब्भत्थणा तओ विहला,न हु सक्कररससित्तोवि चयइ कडुयत्तणं निम्बो
english: If you want to be a poet, Sit down, sit down, take a nap, And don't drink the juice of sugar. You'd better stop being bitter.

prakrit: अहवा कहापबन्धो कीरइ किं दुज्जणाण सङ्काए?,जूयाभएण परिहाणविमोयणं हन्दि! न हु जुत्तं
english: Ahava, what is the use of being bound? Is it to scare away evil spirits? It is the handiwork of a gambler who deceives people. No, I am not.

prakrit: दुज्जणअसंमयं पि हु कुणइ कवी कव्वमेत्थ किमजुत्तं?,उलुयाणमभासन्तोवि दिणयरो किं न उग्गमइ?
english: What is the point of a poet's poem When he speaks in the midst of adversity? But when he speaks his mind, Does not his heart tremble?

prakrit: अपत्थिओवि सुयणो कईण कव्वे गुणे पयासेइ,धवलेइ जयं सयलं सभावओ चेव निसिनाहो
english: Aunt, The virtues of many a poet are destroyed by many a lie, But victory for the white man Depends on how many lies he conceals.

prakrit: निन्दाकारिजणस्स वि दोसग्गाही न सज्जणो कहवि,कुणइ सुयन्धं वासिं तच्छिज्जन्तो वि मलयरुहो
english: Tell me, gentlemen, That there is nothing to be said for being rude, For even a scolded man Can make a good man angry.

prakrit: अन्नं च हवइ हु विरूवयम्पि हु कव्वं सुयणाण सङ्गमे लट्ठं,सिप्पिपुडम्मि पविट्ठं जलम्पि मुत्ताहलं होइ
english: I have food to eat, I am full of tears, And poetry to lie with me in my sleep. May the holy fire of Sippy Pudding burn brightly.

prakrit: अब्भत्थणारिहां जं सुयणा तो ते उ पत्थिमो इण्हिं,एगग्गमणा होउं साहिज्जन्तिं निसामेह
english: The sleeper who is deprived of sleep is like a stone that has fallen from the pyre; let him rest in peace with his lover.

prakrit: घोरे अणोरपारे संसारे जोणिलक्खपउरम्मि,अइदुलहं लद्धूणं मणुयत्तं भवियलोएण
english: I am bound to travel the world again and again, But to enjoy the pleasures of love I will never forget.

prakrit: देविन्दचन्दनागिन्दविन्दमणुइन्दवन्दियजिणेहिं,वज्जरिए उज्जमिउं जुत्तं धम्मम्मि सुद्धम्मि
english: Devindachand, Govindam, Vindhya, Jinnah, Vajraye, Ujjamye, Jutta, Dhamma, Suddhammi.

prakrit: सो अन्तरारिविजए रोगद्दोसा य अन्तरा सत्तू,तव्विजऎ च्चिय सोक्खं तेहिं जियाणं पुणो दुक्खं
english: So, whether one conquers illness or pains the soul, One who conquers happiness conquers sorrow again.

prakrit: एवं च ठिए रागद्देसाणुगया जीवा पावेन्ति विविहदुक्खाइं,तम्हा तव्विजऎ च्चिय विबुहेहिं होइ जइयव्वं
english: In the same way, when one is angry one gets life by enduring various sufferings. So let your anger be destroyed by your anger.

prakrit: एयत्थसाहणपरा सोलसपरिच्छेयसङ्गया ललिया,पाइयगाहाहिं कहा कीरइ सुरसुन्दरीनामा
english: Aunt, How can I describe her?"" asked Laliya, sitting crossly on top of her husband, As if she were talking to a beautiful woman.

prakrit: अबुहजणबोहणं तह दुक्कहलोयाण चित्तरञ्जणयं,जुगवं णो सक्किज्जइ कवीहिं उभयम्पि काऊण
english: Love is like a painting on wood, Like pain in a painting, Like youth in a poem, Like a poem in verse.

prakrit: जओ सालङ्कारेण घणक्खरेण रञ्जिज्जए जणो विबुहो,पयडत्थललियकव्वं अबुहाणं बोहणं कुणइ
english: A man whose hair is dyed with nectar Is like a pot of water on the fire, Like an earthenware vessel drained of pollen.

prakrit: दोण्ह वि एक्कवएच्चिय सक्किज्जइ रञ्जणं न काऊणं,एक्कं गेण्हन्ताणं अवस्स किर नासए बीयं
english: Two people can do the same thing, Don't confuse the colors. One person can't control the weather, So why waste time sowing seeds?

prakrit: नियगुरुकमप्पसाया कावि हु सत्ती उ जइवि मह अत्थि,उवमासिलेसरूपगवण्णगबहुलम्मि कव्वम्मि
english: Niyagurukamappasaya kavi hu satti, Jivi me atathi, Uvamaseelasaroopa gavanaga: The poetry of many poets.

prakrit: तहवि हु तयं न कीरइ असमत्थं पत्थुअम्मि जं अत्थे,तो अबुहबोहणत्थं पयडत्था कीरए एसा
english: Then why didn't you do the same thing to the stone on which you had stuck it?

prakrit: किञ्च सीसिणिमयहरियाए गुरुभगिणीए अलन्धवयणाए,सिरिकल्लाणमईए पवत्तिणीए उ वयणेण
english: Some sesame seeds are so fragrant That the teacher's wife takes them in her arms, And Sirikallanam gives them to her stepdaughter.

prakrit: पारद्धा जं एसा कवित्तगव्वेण नो मए तेण,कीरइउत्ताणत्था पाइयगाहाहिं ललियपया
english: Believe me, my dear, If this poem were not written by me It would be better not to write it at all.

prakrit: हु पज्जत्तं बहुणा पत्थुयविग्धावहेण विहलेण,विहवकुलबालियाकयकडक्खविक्खेवसरिसेणं
english: I am the only one who knows how to travel, Like a child prodigy Whose arms are twisted around his waist.

prakrit: निसुणह एगग्गमणा होउमियाणिं कहं कहिज्जन्तं,अड̣धाइज्जसएहिं गाहाणं कयपरिच्छेयं
english: Without saying a word, How can I explain this to you?"" asked the haughty woman.

prakrit: अत्थेत्थ सुवित्थिन्नो उड̣धाहोलोगमज्झयारम्मि,नामेण तिरियलोगो विबुहाणुगओ सुमेरुव्व
english: At the same time, spring flies from above, Like the rays of the sun in the sky, Like a lotus twisted by the name of summer.

prakrit: दीवो उ अत्थि तत्थवि वित्थरओ जोयणाण लक्खं तु,जलहिवलयावगụ̄धो जम्बुद्दीवो त्ति विक्खाओ
english: The lamp has gone out, So hast thou scattered abroad the joys and sorrows of youth. But when it is time to light a lamp, It goes out.

prakrit: तस्स य दाहिणभागे भरहं नामेण अत्थि वरखेत्तं,वेयड्ढनगवरेणं दुहा विहत्तं सुवित्थिन्नं
english: There on the right is a field with my husband's name on it, And on the left a field full of weeds.

prakrit: अह दाहिणड्ढभरहे गङ्गासिन्धूण मज्झयारम्मि,कप्पदुमोव्व दुमाणं बहुदेसाणं पहाणयारो
english: Ah! the water of the Ganges flows from the right side to the left side of my body, Like the lotus on a lotus.

prakrit: धन्नसमिद्धिलपामररासयसंसद्दपूरियदियन्तो,अविकरहमहिसरासहनाणाविहगोहणाइन्नो
english: Blessed is the parliamentarian whose business is concluded between two and three days, Unhappiness is the hallmark of a virtuous marriage

prakrit: पइदियहवहन्ताणेयसारणीविसररेहिरुज्जाणो,पुरनगरगामपउरो बहुरिद्धिसमिद्धसयलजणो
english: Are you afraid of the wind whirling around you When you arrive in town? The traveler is familiar with many things.

prakrit: निच्चं पमुइयलोओ नाणाविहउच्छवेहिं अविरहिओ,भयडमररहियगामो कुरुत्ति नामेण वरदेसो
english: Stop being so touchy, You fool, And stop being so fearful. I will reward you with a good name.

prakrit: अविय अणवरयवहन्ताणेयवणियसत्थोहवसिमसयलपहो,जत्थ न नज्जइ पहि पहिं अडविवसिठाणयविसेसो
english: Traveler, don't travel unless you find it difficult to balance your feet on the uneven surface of the ground.

prakrit: अन्नं च तम्मि देसे गुणाण भवणम्मि एयमच्छरियं,सोअरहिओवि जं सुणइ जणवओ लोयभणियाइं
english: When one speaks of one's own virtues One mutters good and bad words. But when one listens one speaks falsehoods.

prakrit: अविय जत्थ य गाममहल्ला कररहिया धम्मवज्जिया मुणिणो,देसस्स तस्स संवण्णणम्मि को उज्जमं कुणइ?
english: Anyway, When the village headman is sowing the seeds of dharma, How bright is that sunny day in the country?

prakrit: तत्थवि य अत्थि वित्थिन्नजलहिवलयाणुकारिपरिहाए,परपुरिसालङ्घाए परिक्खित्तं भमिरमयराए
english: At the same time the parrots are scattered all over the place, Like water buffaloes caught in the crossfire of another tiger's tail.

prakrit: पडवक्खभयुप्पायणविसालसालेण परिगयं रम्मं,रमणीयमगरतोरणगोउरदारेहिं परिकिन्नं
english: Love is like a lotus Placed on the palm of one's hand, Like a panorama propped up against the girdle of a lovely street.

prakrit: अइनीलबहलउववणविरायमाणावसाणभागेहिं,मत्तालम्बगवक्खयजुएहिं वरचित्तजुत्तेहिं
english: Lucky are the trees that grow blue, Lucky the bushes on the river bank, Happy the juicy shoots of a drunken cow.

prakrit: नाणभूमिजुएहिं पासाएहिं तुसारधवलेहिं,तन्नयरवासिजणजसथूहेहिव्व निच्चमइरम्मं
english: A coin has to pass through the eyes of a young man, Like the pearl of your hand That does not budge When touched by an angry man.

prakrit: तह अवरावरदेसागएण तन्नयरवासिणा चेव,वणियकलानिउणेणं पइदियहं वणियलोएण
english: So do not neglect your neighbor in distant lands, For I have become acquainted with the arts of trade Through my travels in the forest.

prakrit: किज्जन्तवणिज्जेहिं विरायमाणं अणेगहट्टेहिं,परिपूरिएहिं अन्तो बहुमुल्लकियाणगसएहिं
english: What a waste of time It is to travel alone, To be completely exhausted And end up as something very valuable.

prakrit: उत्तुङ्गमगरतोरणपवणुद्धुयधवलधयवडड̣धेहिं,सुदंरदेवउलेहिं उवसोहियसुन्दरपएसं
english: May the gods rejoice over her With towering waves, May the clouds cover her with clouds, May she enjoy the pleasures of love

prakrit: तह पण्डुपउमसण्डोहमण्डियाणेयगुरुतरसरेहिं,सोवाणपन्तिसुगमावयारवावीसहस्सेहिं
english: There at the feet of Pandupuma swollen with sweat, At the tips of the thickets of jasmine flowers, The wife sighs with delight at her husband's return.

prakrit: वरतियचउक्कचच्चरआरामुज्जाणदीहियाईहिं,देवाणमवि कुणन्तं पए पए चित्तसंहरणं
english: The God of Love has turned our hearts upside down, Our eyes red with delight.

prakrit: सयलन्नपुरपहाणं नयरं सिरिहत्थिणाउरं नाम,नयरगुणोहुववेयं सङ्कासं अमरनयरस्स
english: Silence is the name of the path, The sound of one's feet, The sighs of a jealous husband Are the rays of immortality.

prakrit: जत्थ य निवसइ लोओ पियंवओ धम्मकरणतल्लिच्छो,दक्खिन्नचायभोगेहिं सङ्गओ तह कलाकुसलो
english: Wherever people live, Beloved ones, Meditate on Dharma; Together with those who seek refuge in the south, There is bound to be art.

prakrit: जत्थ य पुरम्मि निच्चं इओ तओ बहुपओयणपरेण,भमिरजणसमुदएणं दुस्सञ्चाराओ रत्थाओ
english: Wherever the Puram is approached, There are many steps, And the wicked charioteer runs through the crowd of pilgrims.

prakrit: जत्थ य कोडिपडायापच्छाइयसयलगयणमग्गम्मि,लोओ गिम्हदिणेसुवि रविकरतावं न याणेइ
english: Wherever kodipadaya is painted, Or on the steps of a riverbank, People do not know the nature of the sun during summer.

prakrit: जत्थ य पुरम्मि पुरिसा घरभित्तिनिहित्तमणिमऊहेहिं,निच्चं हयन्धयारे गयम्पि राइं न याणन्ति
english: Wherever the men of the village are, There are arrows stuck in the walls of their houses. Yet they do not know the ways of the hunter's wife.

prakrit: रम्मत्तणओ जस्स य पलोयणत्थंव आगया देवा,कोउगवक्खित्तमणा अणमिसनयणत्तणं पत्ता
english: The fire of the God of Love, Like the flame of love, Is the medicine of anger and resentment.

prakrit: धवलहरसिहरविरइयपवणपहल्लन्तवेजयन्तीओ,सन्नन्ति व रविणो सारहिस्स अइउच्चगमणट्ठा
english: The sun is shining brightly, The flowers are blooming, The nights are dark, And the nights are long.

prakrit: जत्थ य पुरम्मि दीसइ पायपहारो उ रङ्गभूमीसु,दण्डो उ धयवडाणं सीसच्छेओ जुयारीण
english: Wherever the poor girl steps There is a stage on which to play, A stick is tied to her head And a yoke is blown on her.

prakrit: कुसुमाण सिरसि बन्धो सागच्छेत्तेसु जीवकत्तणया,तह पण्डियपरिसासु पत्ताणं हन्दि! भिन्दणया
english: Kusumaan sirsi bandho saag chhote sujivakatna, thoda pandiya parisaasu padta handi! Bhindanaaya.

prakrit: अह एक्कॊ च्चिय दोसो गुणाण भवणम्मि तम्मि नयरम्मि,निद्दोससाहुणो जं सयावि दीसन्ति गुत्तिठिया
english: Ah! one thing is certain: By feigning guilt She has reduced him to nothing. But, dear friend, The signs she sees are fleeting.

prakrit: अह तम्मि पुरम्मि पहू पभूयकरितुरयरयणभण्डारो,जहभणियनीइपालणआणन्दियसयसजणचित्तो
english: Ah! your poor daughter - in - law, You foolish traveler, Who for so long has looked after her with such fondness And with such a generous heart.

prakrit: नियबुद्धिसमुदएणं वसीकयासेससत्तुसन्ताणो,सम्पूरियत्थिसमुदयमणपत्थियअत्थवित्थारो
english: Are you satisfied with what you get out of your wretched mind, Your children, Wholehearted men, Steady as a sheet of paper?

prakrit: दढकạधिणभुया 'परिमियपरक्कमक्कन्तसयलपडिवक्खो,पडिवक्खभामिणीवयणनलिणसङ्कोयमणमयङ्को
english: Look! There she is!"" whispered the hunter. ""Parimpriyaparakkamkantasailapadivokkho,"" That's the way it is with a cotton swab stuck in a cotton bunny's eye.

prakrit: सूरोव्व पिहुपयावो सीहो इव अकयपरबलासङ्को,उयहिव्व सुगम्भीरो चन्दो इव जणमणाणन्दो
english: The sun is hotter than the moon, The wind is stronger than fire, The sky is brighter than water, And the moon is more agreeable to human life.

prakrit: रुवेण कामदेवो बुद्धिए सुरगुरुस्स सारिच्छो,निवसइ पमोयपत्तो राया सिरिअमरकेउत्ति
english: With tears running down her cheeks She dwells in the hollow of Raya Siriamara's tree, Who is the god of love, The god of wisdom and goodness.

prakrit: तस्स य तिवग्गसारं रज्जसिरिं सम्ममणुहवन्तस्स,वच्चन्ति वासराइ इन्दस्स व देवलोगम्मि
english: There it is, Like a lightning bolt, Like the bow of a bow That travels through the sky To the gods of the Indus.

prakrit: अह अन्नया कयाइवि अत्थाणगयस्स राइणो तस्स,विणयपणउत्तमङ्गो पडिहारो बन्धुलो भणई
english: Oh, my! There must be something very strange going on there,"" said the farmer,'A friend of mine who is a farmer by profession.

prakrit: देव! कुसग्गपुराओ चित्तयरो चित्तकम्मपत्तट्ठो,नामेण चित्तसेणो समागतो चिट्ठइ दुवारे
english: Deva! The path of anger, Which leads from the heart to the heart, Is joined with the mind through the door of writing.

prakrit: सो देवपायदंसणसुहकङ्खी इच्छए इह पवेसं,एवं च ठिए अम्हं देवाएसो पमाणन्ति
english: That is why those who desire to see the gods rejoice - they desire to be seen by us, and we worship them as gods.

prakrit: तत्तो रण्णा भणियं लहुं पवेसेहि ताहे सो विहिणा,अत्थाणम्मि पविट्ठो कयविणओ राइणो पुरओ
english: There ran the buffalo, And just as the plowman had arrived at the field, So had the hunter."" ""For how can a pious cow ever make a poor cow?

prakrit: उवविट्ठो भूमीए रन्ना भणिओ कुओ 'सि तं भद्द!?,केण व कज्जेण इहं समागओ मह समीवम्मि?
english: Whom are you looking for?"" cried the doe, ""Who is that? It is a bad man!"" said the she - elephant. ""For what reason have you come so close to me?

prakrit: तो भणइ चित्तसेणो कुसग्गनयराउ आगओ देव!,चित्तगरो साइसयं जाणामि य चित्तकम्ममहं
english: So tell me, Cursed be the fire of anger! For all I know about anger, I know how to be angry.

prakrit: चित्तप्पिओ य देवो सुम्मइ वत्तासुं तेण अहमेत्थ,चित्तकलं पयडेउं समागओ देवपासम्मि
english: If the mind is busy thinking, The Deity stays calm. So do not worry, For when you think, You become absorbed in the thoughts of Deity.

prakrit: तत्तो रन्ना भणियं केरिसयं चित्तकोसलं तुज्झ?,दंसेहि ताव मज्झं आलिहियं किञ्चि वररुवं
english: What makes you think I'm angry? You're angry, Daughter - in - law. So why am I still angry?

prakrit: अह तेण कक्खदेसम्मि गोविया चित्तपट्टिया सहसा,पयडीकाउं रण्णो समप्पिया हिट्ठवयणेण
english: Ah! the Goan palette is bursting at the seams At the same time as the cowgirl's.

prakrit: पसरन्तपयडपुलओ राया पुलोएइ तत्थ आलिहियं,नाणावन्नयकलियं पमाणरेहाहिं सुविसुद्धं
english: A wide expanse of grass, Pulo raya flowers, And a lotus blossom at the tips of the leaves - The pleasures of love are endless.

prakrit: अहिणवज्जोव्वणवररुवजुत्तमच्चन्तमणहरागारं,अहिणवसिहिणारम्भं कण्णाए रुवयं पवरं
english: The fire of non - violence is like the lotus of the sky: From the start of a non - violent fight There are bound to be tears.

prakrit: तं दट्ठुं नरनाहो चिन्तइ एसो हु चित्तकम्मम्मि,अइकुसलो जं लिहियं अउव्वरुवं इमं रूवं
english: Look at that man. He thinks I'm delirious. Try writing a letter to him: It'll look just like that.

prakrit: तिलोक्कम्मिवि मन्ने एरिसरूवा न इत्थिया अत्थि,चित्तकलानिउणत्ता अदिट्ठरूवा इमा लिहिया
english: Tilokkammivi manne erisruva ittaiya atthi, citta kala niyunta aditruva ima likhia.

prakrit: जइ पुण कत्थवि होज्जा एरिसरुवेण इत्थिया कन्ना,तीए वि सङ्गमो जइ ता रज्जं होज्ज सकयत्थं
english: If a man wants to be virtuous, He can do so only with water; if he likes dancing, There must be a rope with him.

prakrit: एवं चिन्तेन्तस्स य वम्महसरगोयरम्मि पडियस्स,वीसरिओ से अप्पा चित्ते 'वक्खित्तचित्तस्स
english: And when he thinks of you, He goes on singing about you:"" ""Your mind is devoid of emotions.

prakrit: तत्तो खणन्तराओ संमीलियलोयणो अमरकेऊ,सीहासणाउ पडिओ मुच्छाए परवसो सहसा
english: So the hunter's wife has fallen at once, Like an immortal doe in a dream, Like a pearl on the head.
