english: The youngest daughter of Jayasena is stuck between her husband and dharma, so what do you mean,"" ""Your highness, Samya?"" ""How come you are still sitting here?

prakrit: इय देवसम्मभणियं सोउं सम्भन्तलोयणो सहसा,अह भणइ सुप्पइट्ठो मुञ्चह मुञ्चह महाभागं
english: This is the God of Love,"" he said, ""I suppose you'd better sleep, for I have a big part in this.

prakrit: पासट्ठियपुरिसेहिं तक्खणमुच्छोडिया य से बन्धा,पल्लीवइणा ताहे अवगụ̄धो सायरं एसो
english: The pastime of cooking is tied to the tip of one's nose, But when the village headman sees it, He says:"" ""Here comes the sire.

prakrit: तत्तो विहियपणामो तक्कालमुचियम्मि आसणे दिन्ने,पासट्ठियपुरिसेहिं,उवविट्ठो तत्थ धणदेवो
english: Then I will give you a drink, And you will give me a seat at my feet, Like the supply of pasta. There you will find the god of arms.

prakrit: तत्तो य दीहदीहं नीससिय विसायगब्भिणं एवं,लज्जावणमियवयणो पल्लिवई भणिउमाढत्तो
english: That's when the shy girl said,"" ""It's been a long day."" ""With a sigh of relief And a shy expression On her face The palanquin went up in flames.

prakrit: परमुवगारित्ति तुमं उवेच्च किलहोसि अम्ह दट्ठवो,नवरं गिहागयस्सवि सागयमेवंविहं विहियं!
english: You are so attractive, my dear, That I can see you with my own eyes, Like the sapphires of a good poem!

prakrit: जायइ अवगारफलो विहिओ पावाणं अहव उवयारो,सप्पस्स जहा दिन्नं दुद्धम्पि विसत्तणमुवेइ
english: If you want to eat fruit without burning it, Drink milk without boiling it.

prakrit: पावो अहं कयग्धो सुयजीवियदायगस्स जेणज्ज,गिहमागयस्स एयं अहम्मकम्मं समायरियं
english: Come, let me tell you something. For if I had my life to live on, You'd be damned! Such is the beauty of the heart.

prakrit: भणियं धणदेवेणं कीस इमं वहह गुरुविसायन्ति,अन्नाणं अवरज्झइ,को दोसो एत्थ तुम्हाणं?
english: Tell me, brother - in - law, why do you need a guru in this world, When food is scarce, Who is to blame?

prakrit: दट्ठुं अणन्नसरिसं भिल्लवई तस्स वयणविन्नाणं,रूवं तह सुयणत्तं पुणोवि अइरञ्जिओ भणइ
english: Look at that woman Whose face is smeared with red ghee, Look at her breasts Which are covered with gooseflesh.

prakrit: पेच्छह एगम्मि नरे केत्तियगुणसमुदओ समं वसइ?,बहुरयणा हु वसुमई सच्चो लोयप्पवाओ 'यं
english: Do you see how many virtues reside in the same person?,"" ""I live in a world where many people are ignorant.

prakrit: धी! धी! मह पुरिसत्तं धी! धी! मह एरिसाए वित्तीए,नियकुलकलङ्कभूयस्स मज्झ धी! पुरिसजम्मेण
english: Dhee! Dhee! My husband's daughter! Dee! My wife's son. My daughter - in - law's husband! It's my daughter Who is haunted by nightmares.

prakrit: धी! मज्झ जीविएण कुकम्मनिरयस्स धम्मरहियस्स,एयारिसपुरिसाणं लुण्टणकम्मम्मि निरयस्स
english: Daughter! Keep me alive, you rascal, And do not trouble me by robbing me of my treasure.

prakrit: एत्तियमेत्तेणं चिय धन्नो 'हं जं महाणुभावस्स,अक्खयदेहस्स इमस्स दंसणं झत्ति सञ्जायं
english: It's my good fortune that I ever felt so great, For it was only a matter of time Before I saw him again.

prakrit: जइ पुण होज्ज विवत्ती समयं भिल्लेहिं जुज्झमाणस्स,ता कह मज्झ अउन्नस्स होज्ज पावस्स नित्थारो?
english: If I am to be restored, If I spend the rest of my life fighting, How can I be still?

prakrit: एमाइ बहुविगप्पं अप्पाणं निन्दिऊण तो भणइ,भो! भो! भिल्ला सत्थे जं गहियं एत्थ तुम्हेहिं
english: If you condemn yourself for being so big, I will tell you,"" ""Bhola!"" ""But the village where I am staying is yours.

prakrit: तं सव्वम्पि समप्पह इमस्स धणदेवनामवणियस्स,तेहिं तणमज्जायं समप्पियं तस्स तं सव्वं
english: He knows everything, I know everything, And he knows everything.

prakrit: तत्तो सबालवुड̣धे मिलिए लोगम्मि भयविमुक्कम्मि,वज्जरइ सुप्पइट्ठो धणदेवं नेहगब्भमिणं
english: There you will meet the God of Love, Who in a dream foretells the horrors of war.

prakrit: एत्तो गाउयमेत्ते सीहगुहा नाम अत्थि मे पल्ली,तीए लहुमागच्छह अज्ज मह पाहुणा होह
english: Here in this village, Close to my heart, There's a cave named Atthi in the village, And looking out for her you must be my guest today.

prakrit: भणियं धणदेवेणं एवं होउत्ति ताहे सो सत्थो,धणदेवमग्गलग्गो सीहगुहं झत्ति सम्पत्तो
english: Friend, the god of arms and the hunter are one and the same, But between the gods of arms There is a treasure hidden in a cave.

prakrit: आवासियस्स तत्तो वसिमासन्नम्मि सत्थलोयस्स,पल्लीवइणा नीओ धणदेवो निययगहेम्मि
english: Stay where you are, Sit where you sleep, And do not trouble the village headman. For the lord of the village does not prescribe wealth.

prakrit: अब्भङ्गिऊण विहिणा सुगन्धतेल्लेहिं पवरजुवईहिं,अद्धाणपरिस्समनासगेण वरवारिणा न्हविओ
english: When the bridegroom is about to be presented with his fragrant oil She does not need to bathe with the fragrance of jasmine flowers.

prakrit: घणसारसारसिरिखण्डचच्चिओ ताहे पल्लिनाहेण,सहिओ पवराहारं भोत्तूण समुट्ठिओ कमसो
english: The grasshopper is so thin that it cannot climb on top of the tree, Friend, Stop eating the straw That has stuck to the tree.

prakrit: कप्पूरपूरसहिए तम्बोले आयरेण से दिन्ने,वज्जरइ धणदेवो सुहासणत्थो इमं वयणं
english: The tambola with camphor flowers gives iron, The vajra with its sweet nectar Is the weapon of the God of Love.

prakrit: एसा हु ताव पल्ली आवासो निग्धिणस्स लोयस्स,तुब्भेवि तस्स पहुणो अणन्नसोज्जन्नदयकलिया
english: Such is the state of affairs in the village, O lonely man, That when you approach him He feels as if he has arrived unexpectedly.

prakrit: एसो न सम्मजोगो अहिवइभिच्चाण मह ठियं चित्ते,जं सोयसच्चदक्खिन्नवज्जियाणं इमं ठाणं
english: Do not believe me, my dear, For my mind is fixed on this, Which is bound to cause embarrassment to the observer of right views.

prakrit: भिल्लाणं नाहावि हु जं एरिसगुणगणेण सञ्जुत्ता,एयं मणम्मि भावइ महन्तमच्छेरयं मज्झ
english: I am not the villian Whom the virtuous countenance demands, Such is the nature of the mind As that of a great mermaid.

prakrit: असरिससोजन्नजुया तुम्हे एयाए वसह पल्लीए,उत्तमनरावि होउं साहह मह केण कज्जेण?
english: Young man, you have to live in such a village, To be a good husband - What business do you have with me?

prakrit: तो भणइ सुपइट्ठो किं कहिएणं इमेण धणदेव!,वञ्चणमवमाणं चिय मइजुत्तो नो पगासेज्जा
english: So tell me, stupid god! What do I say, you deceitful wretch? For he is not worthy of my affection.

prakrit: तहवि हु भणामि मा होउ तुज्झ अब्भत्थणा इमा विहला,एगग्गमणो होउं साहिज्जन्तं निसामेहि
english: Then I will tell you, Don't be so naïve: I am leaving you empty - handed. I can go on as long as I like.

prakrit: निच्चं पमुइयनरनारिपुत्रगामावलीए रमणीओ,बहुदिवसवन्नणिज्जो अङ्गो नामेण देसो 'त्थि
english: Dear women, The name of that part of your body Which has not had a bath for many days Is Despicable.

prakrit: तम्मि य पुरं पुराणं पवरं सुरनयरसरिसरिद्धिल्लं,भयडमरकरविमुक्कं सिद्धत्थपुरन्ति विक्खायं
english: Your whole Purana, Surrounded by myriads of fragrant rays, Has been completely destroyed Without a trace of principle.

prakrit: तम्मि य मयन्धरिउकरडिकरडनिब्भेयणम्मि पत्तट्ठो,कम्बुन्नयसुग्गीवो सुग्गीवो नाम नरनाहो
english: A man whose name is Narada should either rejoice or rejoice, For if he loves a woman's milk or sweets His name should be Narada.

prakrit: सयलोरोहपहाणा सुन्दरसरदिन्दुबिम्बसमवयणा,बुद्धीए अणन्नसमा कमला नामेण से देवी
english: Saylorohaphana is beautiful, Like the rays of the sun, Like a goddess endowed with wisdom, Kamala by name.

prakrit: तीए सह विसयसोक्खं अणुहवमाणस्स तह य रज्जधुरं,पुव्वभवपुन्नपायवसमप्पियं पालयन्तस्स
english: With her went a long and arduous search, Which, though uneven, Redoubled with pleasure, Endured without interruption.

prakrit: वच्चन्तेसु दिणेसुं तीए देवीए अह अहं पुत्तो,जाओ कयं च नामं विहिणा मह सुप्पइट्ठॊत्ति
english: Come, my son, I will give you one day at a time And you will put me to sleep In my name.

prakrit: लालिज्जन्तो पञ्चहिं धाईहिं कमेण वड्ढमाणो 'हं,सञ्जाओ पञ्चवरिसो माउपिऊणं कयाणन्दो
english: If you want to be pampered five times a day, keep at it."" ""Yes, father - in - law! Five times a year Is too much for one's parents To bear

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि गिम्हे सन्तावियमहियले वइक्कन्ते,निव्ववियमहीवị̄धो रसन्तसालूरसङ्घाओ
english: Hereafter the scent of summer fades, Like the fragrance of spring.

prakrit: पवहन्तबहलवाहिणिखलहलसंसद्दबहिरियदिगन्तो,गज्जन्तगहिरजलहरदंसणनच्चन्तसिहिनिवहो
english: Be careful not to fall into the trap of falling asleep on your feet, For you must be anxious to see the water in the swollen lake

prakrit: पप्फुल्लफुल्लसोहियनीवोहविरायमाणवणनियरो,मुचकुन्दकुडयसन्दियरयगब्भिणवाइयसमीरो
english: Dear friends, The words you utter echo those of your husband's lips When he says:"" ""Be nice to each other.

prakrit: पुलिणपइट्ठियबालयकयवालुयदेउलेहिं रमणीओ,करिसयजणपारम्भियहलउत्तयचच्चियबइल्लो
english: Lovely lady, With round breasts Like a doe's pail, People start to behave as if they were peacock's tail.

prakrit: हरिसवसहसिरपामर दिसि दिसि चब्भत्तभूरिकेयारो,पत्तो वासारत्तो कद्दमदुल्लङ्घमग्गिल्लो
english: You will see the twang of the sesame tree, Like a sapling tossed from the rafters by the wind.

prakrit: एयारिसम्मि नवपाउसम्मि पत्तम्मि अन्नदिवसम्मि,नरनाहो सुग्गीवो विहिणा कयभोयणो सन्तो
english: This is the new moon, That on the following day The sun does not shine, Nor does the wife rejoice, For fear of someone else's fate.

prakrit: चन्दणचच्चियदेहो परिहियमिउसण्हनिम्मलदुगूलो,तम्बोलवग्गहत्थो समागतो देविभवणम्मि
english: The fragrance of the moonlight, The nectar of fragrant flowers, Gathering on the palm of one's hand In the house of the gods.

prakrit: सत्ततले पासाए आरụ̄धो उवरिमाए भूमीए,देवीए कयविणओ महरिहसेज्जाए आसीणो
english: In the heavenly realm, And on the earth above, Where, O goddess, Does the husbandman Sit In ecstasy?

prakrit: खणमेगमच्छिऊणं परिहासकहाहिम्पिययमाए सह,सियवसणच्छाइयाए कोमलतूलीए पासुत्तो
english: It is funny to touch a cloud With the touch of a clap of thunder, To pass by on a soft twig Under the shadow of a cucumber.

prakrit: ततो य सजलजलहरगञ्जियसद्देण नट्ठनिद्दो सो,उट्ठित्तुं संनिविट्ठो निज्जूहगसण्ठियमसूरे
english: As soon as you fall asleep in the middle of the sweltering heat of the Ganges, You awaken and revive your youth.

prakrit: अद्धासणे निविट्ठा कमलदेवीवि ताहे नरपहुणो,वज्जरइ तओ राया हरिसवसुल्लसियरोमञ्चो
english: In the middle of the night the lotus goddess stands erect, So does the man's lover, And when he rises The rays of the sun Are like the rays of a lily in bloom.

prakrit: मह सङ्गमगरुयसमुल्लसन्तमणहरपओहरा झत्ति,पेच्छ पिए! सञ्जाया तुज्झ सरिच्छा कुबेरदिसा
english: I'm about to have my fair share of trouble, You silly girl, Don't drink the wine! Your good name is Sanjaya.

prakrit: तरलत्तं नयणाणं कुडिलत्तं सुतणु! तुज्झ केसाणं,अणुकरइ पेच्छ विज्जू घणमज्झे चिगिचिगायन्ती
english: Liquid, fresh, cool, sleepy! Your hair, dear girl, is falling apart While Viju, wearing a thick skirt, Sings a song.

prakrit: अन्नं च पिय! पेच्छसु परिब्भमन्तेहिं इन्दगोवेहिं,नज्जइ पाउसलच्छी पचुन्निया महीयले पडिया
english: Eat and drink! Look around at that gooseflesh swirling around You."" ""It's like a bee hiding in the mud From the rainy season.

prakrit: पाउसनरिन्दनवसङ्गमम्मि जायम्मि भूमिमहिलाए,हरियङ्कुरच्छलेणं पेच्छसु रोमञ्चओ जाओ
english: Women of the land, When the rain clouds gather Around you, Look how the rays of the crescent Seem to thrill.

prakrit: निट्ठुर करपसरेणं इमेण सन्ताविआ इमा पुहई,इय रोसेणव रुद्धो घणेहिं सूरस्स करपसरो
english: My dear, I am reaching here because I am so distraught at this cruel man's anger. Stop being angry And turn your back on him.

prakrit: मह आगमेवि पियविरहियाण महिलाण किं न फुट्टाइं,हिययाइं सामरिसं विज्जुज्जोएण जोएइ
english: Why should I not break up with a woman who has broken up with me? It is because she has mastered the art of being brave.

prakrit: नाउं मह आगमणं तहवि हु किं चल्लिया पिया मोत्तुं,गज्जन्तो रोसेणव पहियाणं दलइ हिययाइं
english: No, I'm not coming, You silly one, Drunk on pearls? It's the rustle of roses That makes the wheels turn turtle.

prakrit: धवलबलायादạ̄धो विज्जुलयाचवलदीहजीहालो,कसणशरीरो धावइ पहियाणं पाउसपिसाओ
english: The thunderclap, The lightning flashes, The breeze blows, But the rain pours only on the body Running through the wheels.

prakrit: पेच्छ सुरचावनिग्गयधाराबाणेहिं विरहिहिययाइं,विन्धन्तो उवहसइव पञ्चसरं पञ्चसरसहियं
english: Eyes are scattered with the stream of raindrops Running down the rafters, And with the wind they pierce, Five times as many.

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि देवी नरनाहं भणइ हरिसिता सन्ती,सेसउऊण नरवर! अब्भहिओ पाउसो एसो
english: The goddess says,"" ""It's raining men."" ""She replies:"" ""There must be men! But come on, rain!

prakrit: मोत्तूण विरहिणिजणं सुहओ जं एस कामुयजणस्स,पामरवच्छतणोसहिपमुहाणं तहय जीवाणं
english: A man devoid of pearls Is as happy as a hot-tempered man. Life goes on as if he were a sapphire tree.

prakrit: अह भणइ पुहइनाहो ईसिं हसेऊण,देवि! तं सच्चं,आहीणं सञ्जायं जं सुम्मइ एत्थ लोगम्मि
english: Oh! you fool,"" ""he said."" ""Laugh at this! That's true, my dear! There must be something wrong with these people.

prakrit: धाया पुरिसा पेच्छन्ति आयारा धायचं दिसावलयं,तह देवि! तुमं सुहिया सव्वं सुहियन्ति मन्नेसि
english: Dear God, You think everything is pleasant When men and women look at you As if it were.

prakrit: सव्वेवि देवि! उउणो सउन्नलोयस्स हॊन्ति सुहहेऊ,पुन्नविहूणाण पुणो पाउससमओवि दुहहेऊ
english: All goddesses! Happy are they who rejoice in the blossom of sunshine."" ""With renewed vigor Come the pleasures of rainy days.

prakrit: ओ! पेच्छ पेच्छ सुन्दरि! अद्धसमारम्मि जरकुडीरम्मि,ओघसरसयविराइयविराइयडिम्भसमूहे रुयन्तम्मि
english: Oh! Look, pretty girl!"" cried the yokelike girl Who was half dressed And half covered with gooseflesh.

prakrit: निययघरिणीए बाढं चोइज्जन्तो पुणो पुणो वरओ,आवरणरहियदेहो हम्मन्तो वारिधाराहिं
english: If the good wife chooses a good man, He will marry again. But if her body is not preserved, There is always a successor.

prakrit: उद्धुसियरोमकूवो सीयलअनिलेण सङ्कुइयगत्तो,एसो दरिद्दपुरिसो कहकहवि समारइ कुडीरं
english: The poor man said:"" ""This is the body of a poor man Whose hair has shrunk due to the heat of the seals.

prakrit: ओलम्बियकन्नजुयं हम्मन्तं गुरुयवारिधाराहिं,ओलुग्गभग्गदेउलकोणगयं रासभं नियसु
english: Young Olympian, It's still early morning. Wait till the rains come. Once the gods are awake They will arrange a feast for you.

prakrit: तह पेच्छ इमं सुन्दरि! सुणहं चुल्लीए सुन्नगेहम्मि,सीएण कुणुकुणन्तं खरखरखड्डं खणेमाणं
english: Look at that girl! She's so beautiful! I hear the stove humming. It takes until someone knocks on the boulder To dig it out.

prakrit: तह पेच्छ जरबइल्ला जलहरधारावलीहि हम्मन्ता,ईरियासमिउव्व मुणी वच्चन्ति महिं पलोएन्ता
english: There you see a flock of parrots standing in a stream of water. The sage of Iriyas is always on the lookout for me.

prakrit: सेवालियभूमितले फिल्लुसमाणा य थामथामम्मि,हत्थगयलट्ठिखण्डा भिक्खं परियडइ जररोरो
english: The plowman's wife, who is a servant in a poor country, Threw her hands around the poor monk With a clenched fist.

prakrit: एवं च जाव साहइ देवीए ताव कञ्चुई झत्ति,पायवडणुट्ठिओ अह वसुदत्तो भणिउमाढत्तो
english: And when the cowherd said :'Go, help me!'The doe shook her bosom And with a trembling sigh Said :'I am Vasudeva's wife '.

prakrit: देवेण जो उ पुव्विं पट्ठविओ आसि चम्पनयरीए,सिरिकित्तिवम्मरन्नो दूओ दामोदरो नाम
english: The God who gave birth to her first son, Who came to Champaneri, Gave birth to a daughter - in - law By the name of Damodara.

prakrit: सो देवपायदंसणसुहकङ्खी आगओ दुवारम्मि,चिट्ठइ,एवं च ठिए देवो पमाणन्ति तं सोच्चा
english: So the poor girl, longing for the pleasure of seeing the gods, writes a letter, and at the same time thinks that the gods favor her.

prakrit: दिट्ठीए आपुच्छिय देविं सहसत्ति उट्ठिओ राया,अत्थाणमण्डवस्स उ आसन्नो जाव सम्पत्तो
english: When he sees you, God, Eighty-nine steps away, There is nothing more for him to achieve In this heavenly abode.

prakrit: ताव य विज्जुचमुक्कारणन्तरं चण्डचडडसंसद्दो,आसन्नो सञ्जाओ भेसियनरनारिसङ्घाओ
english: When, after a moment's hesitation, the moon appeared in the dark, There was silence all around.

prakrit: तयणन्तरं च महाहारवसंमीसं समुट्ठियं सद्दं,देवीगिहम्मि सोउं सहसा वलिओ महीनाहो
english: After the festival, The whole of Samudrava, including the Mahāharāvāsa, meets in the evening. Suddenly it is the month of Valiyo.

prakrit: वज्जरइ देविधावी रुयमाणी धग्धरेण सद्देण,नरवर! मुट्ठा मुट्ठा देवी विज्जूए दद्धत्ति
english: Wretched woman, Crying flame, Strong man! With a clenched fist The goddess is consumed by poison.

prakrit: दट्ठूण भूमिपडियं देवीदेहं जिएण परिचत्तं,हा! हा! हत्ति भणन्तो राया मुच्छावसं पत्तो
english: When he sees the body of the goddess on the earth, He knows how to live, Ha! Ha! But when he says:"" ""May the moon suit your face,"" ""He leaves.

prakrit: दट्ठूण भूमिपडियं नरनाहं मुच्छियं विगयचेट्ठं,भूरितरो सञ्जातो परियणअक्कन्दसद्दोवि
english: When he sees the surface of the earth Scorched by the rays of the sun His face grows dark.

prakrit: पासट्ठियपुरिसेहिं सीयलपवणाइयम्मि विहियम्मि,रायावि विगयमुच्छो विलविउमेवं समाढत्तो
english: The breeze blows through the pastures, The wind whirls through the paddy fields, And the nights grow dark As if they were tears streaming down her face.

prakrit: हा वल्लहि! हा सामिणि! हा जीवियदायगे! विसालच्छि!,हा मह हिययनिवासिणि! हा! कत्थ गया ममं मोत्तुं?
english: Ha vallahi! Ha samini! Ha jeevidaayage!, Visaalaachi!, Ha mahayavasini!! Ha! How has my mother died?

prakrit: हा गोरदेंहि! हा पिहुपओहरे! हा सुकोमलसरीरे!,हा कह निग्घिणविहिणा तुह उवरिं पाडिया विज्जू?
english: Oh! my blondie! Oh! the peacock's tail, Oh! The dry grasshopper! How can you travel on your back Without blinking?

prakrit: घणसारघुसिणचच्चणउचियसरीरम्मि कह णु हयविहिणा,विज्जूनिवाओ विहिओ मज्झ अउन्नेहिं पावेण?
english: How come, my poor girl, sitting on top of a thick sheet of cotton, Can't you see I've got it in me?

prakrit: हा देवि तुज्झ विरहे नारनारीसङ्कुलं इमं नयरं,उव्वसिंयनयरसरिसं अडविसमाणं च पडिहाइ
english: Oh! the goddess! In your absence, my poor girl, There is nothing more for me to do But sulk all over the summer.

prakrit: किल देवि! तं भणन्ती तुह विरहे अच्छिउं न सक्केमि,तं कह अहं अहन्नो तुमए सहसा परिच्चतो
english: Kill her! I can't help being angry with you When she tells you So. Tell her I'm pregnant. You're suddenly familiar.

prakrit: हा! किं न किम्पि जम्पसि किंवा तं सुयणु! मज्झ रुट्ठा सि,किंव मए अवरद्धं सुन्दरि! तं मज्झ साहेसु?
english: Hey! Why don't you jump in front of me or put me to sleep? I'm on my way, you silly girl. What do you think? It's my lord.

prakrit: तं चिय मह वल्लहिया नेहो मह नत्थि अन्नइत्थीसु,तुज्झ कए परिचत्तो सयलो ओरोहनारिजणो
english: There you are, my dear, There's nothing more for me to do, You clever man, Known only to you.

prakrit: तहवि तुमं किं सुन्दरी! निब्भररत्तस्स देसि नालावं?,ता पसिय पसिय सामिणि! उट्ठिय मह देसु पडिवयणं
english: So what beauty is that to you? Can't you see that I have a heart of gold? Please, dear girl, get up and show me the way.

prakrit: एमाइ जाव विलवइ विविहं राया सकलुणसद्देण,ताव अहं सम्पत्तो रोवन्तो तत्थ धणदेव!
english: I can make a wide variety of dishes, With all my might, So when I cry out for wealth, That is the god of wealth!

prakrit: उच्छङ्गे विणिवेसिय ममं तओ गाढकलुणसद्देण,तं चेव पलवमाणो सुदीहरं रुवइ बालोव्व
english: Wretched woman, Your face looks like a lotus, And your cheeks like jasmine: You're the only one who cries for joy.

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि मन्ती सुमईनामो भणइ नरनाह,देव! अलं रुन्नेण मयकिच्चं कुणह देवीए
english: That woman says my name all the time:"" ""Narna ̄ ha, deva! Please, goddess, stop making me cry!

prakrit: भणइ तओ नरनाहो चन्दणदारूणि बाहिं नीणेह,देवीए जेण समयं अहम्पि अग्गीए विस्सामि
english: Tell me, my poor girl, Why don't you just light a fire with the moonlight? For all the time I spend thinking of the goddess, I am wasting away in the fire.

prakrit: तो भणइ सुमइमन्ती कायरजणचेट्ठिएण किं इमिणा,मरण 'ज्झवसाऐणं,अवलम्बसु धीर! धीरत्तं
english: So tell me, Silly girl, Why this humility When you see people so cowardly? Stop being so stubborn And be patient.

prakrit: मरणेण तुज्झ नरवर! देसो सव्वोवि होइ जं गम्मो,पडिवक्खनरवराणं बालो तह सुपइट्ठॊत्ति
english: On your deathbed you are a coward! Everything you do Will be in vain, For as the hair of your rivals grows, So will your beauty.

prakrit: देवाणं बम्भणाण य लिगीणं तह पागयजणस्स,धम्मकिरियाओ सव्वा वहन्ति देवे धरन्तम्मि
english: Whether the gods are angry or angry, The pagans know this, The God of Dharma carries all actions on earth.

prakrit: महिलामेत्तस्स कए न हु जुत्तं तुम्ह उत्तमनराण,असमञ्जसमायरिउं विन्नायजगस्सभावाणं
english: With women I am not what you think I am, with incompatible feelings of worthlessness and worldliness.

prakrit: अविय निरुवक्कमकायस्सवि उसभजिणिन्दस्स आइदेवस्स,मरणं जायं जइया का गणणा अन्नमणुएसु?
english: Aviya niruvakkam kayasavi that vegetarian god, Have you considered whether death will come to you?

prakrit: निज्जियपडिवक्खस्सवि छक्खण्डमहीसरस्स भरहस्स,जइया जायं मरणं का गणणा अन्नमणुएसु
english: Have a hearty laugh, sweetwood tree, As long as you don't count on death.

prakrit: गरुयपरक्कमनिज्जियरिउबलपाइक्कच्चक्ककयरक्खा,सोण्डीरा नरवइणो सोमजसा ' 'इच्चजसपमुहा
english: Look!"" ""growled the farmer's daughter - in - law, Pecking her toes against the nail marks on his cheek,"" ""It looks like a snake biting into a parrot's beak.

prakrit: जइ ताव ते य निहाया पावकयन्तेण निग्घिणमणेण,अनिवारियपसरेणं का गणणा अन्नलोयम्मि?
english: If so, by the mere thought of staring at your lover's face, Is the arrow counting toward the forehead?

prakrit: जेसिम्पि य तित्तीसं आउयमुदहीण पवरदेवाणं,तेसिम्पि होइ चवणं का गणणा अन्नसत्तेसु?
english: As soon as you see a parrot, Without a mouth to feed it, Are you sure you can count the number of times it has been bitten?

prakrit: भवणवइवाणमन्तरजोइसियाणं विमणवासीणं,जइ नाम होइ चवणं का गणणा मणुयलोयम्मि?
english: A man who lives in a plane, Who lives in an airplane, Likes to travel by himself, And whose name is supposed to denote the count of four?

prakrit: सो कोवि नत्थि जीवो तिलोयमज्झम्मि जो वसं न गओ,मच्चुस्स पावमइणो मोत्तुं सिद्धे सुहसमिद्धे
english: So what kind of creature is there in the lake that won't settle down? A poor man's pearl is perfectly pleasant to touch.

prakrit: इय कालकवलियं पेच्छिऊण सयलम्पि तिहुअणं देव!,जायम्मि देविमरणे किं सोगं कुणह विहलं तु?
english: Oh! my god! When this goddess is dead, Why are you in such a state of mourning?

prakrit: जुज्जइ काउं सोगो मरणं जइ होज्ज तीए एक्काए,साहारणम्मि मरणे को सोगो किंव रुन्नेण?
english: If war be the cause of sorrow or death, why should she weep when she is alone? For who can be sorrowful when he is dead?

prakrit: अइतणुतणग्गसङ्गयजललवतुल्लम्मि जीवियव्वम्मि,निद्दासङ्गे जं पुण उट्ठिज्जइ तं महच्छरियं
english: The fresh water that flows from the eaves Is the lifeblood of all living beings; That which rises again with sleep Is like a beehive.

prakrit: इय लोयस्स सरूवं कुवियकयन्तस्स एरिसं दट्ठुं,देविमरणम्मि नरवर! न हु जुत्तं सोगकरणन्ति
english: Here is the god of death, The God of Love! No one will mourn your death.

prakrit: एवं च बहुविगप्पं भणिओ सो सुमइणा नरवरिन्दो,तक्कालुचियं सव्वं मइकिच्चं कुणइ देवीए
english: And tell me, darling, That handsome man and woman, Who in their right mind have mastered all sorts of tricks, Are goddesses.

prakrit: कइवयदिणाइं परिचत्तलोयसम्भावणाइवावारो,गहगहिओ इव चिट्ठइ राया देवीए सोगेण
english: Those who cherish affection for one's beloved - The goddess Raya - Write such long letters in grief.

prakrit: सुमइमुहेहिं तावय नाणाविहसोयमोयणपडूहिं,बोहिज्जन्तो गिराहिं जाओ कालेण गयसोगो
english: The moment you see him face to face You will rejoice, For when he is angry You will be angry.

prakrit: नाऊण अट्ठवरिसं ममं तओ गरुयपुत्तनेहेण,सङ्गहिय उवज्झायं गाहेइ कलाणसन्दोहं
english: Now that I've been married for eight years, my husband loves me too, And he loves me just the same.

prakrit: गहिए कलाकलावे गामसहस्सं तया महं दिन्नं,मह दंसणेण राया साहारइ देविविरहम्पि
english: Please, village headman, please, don't give it to me. The gods are averse to my seeing Raya again.

prakrit: अह अन्नया कयाइवि अत्थाणगयस्स राइणो झत्ति,पणमिय दुवारवालो वज्जरइ सूहवो एवं
english: Ah! how strange it is to hear the rainbow singing loudly, Like the trumpet call of a moneylender.

prakrit: चम्पापुरीओ सामिय! महन्तओ कित्तिधम्मनरवइणो,देवस्स दंसणत्थं चिट्ठइ पडिहारभूमीए
english: Champapuri, Samiya! What a man of dharma! She pines to see the gods on the plain.

prakrit: सिग्घं पवेससुत्ति य भणिए सो राइणा अणुन्नाओ,आगम्म विहियविणओ उवविट्ठो उचियठाणम्मि
english: When he said:"" ""Praise be to the lion,"" ""The rhinoceros looked on in exasperation.

prakrit: तम्बोलाइपयच्छणपुव्वं सो राइणा समुल्लविओ,आगमकारणं भो! साहसु तो भणिउमाढत्तो
english: Come on, you rhinoceros!"" ""You dare say,"" ""It's raindrops all over again!

prakrit: चम्पाए पुरवरीए सुपसिद्धो चेव देवपायाणं,वित्थारियविमलकित्ती राया सिरिकित्तिधम्मो 'त्थि
english: Champaye purwariye suprasiddha se devapayana, vitthariya vimalakitti raaya sirikitthi dharma thi.

prakrit: निज्जियसुरिन्दसुन्दरिरूवातिसया समत्थमहिलाण,अब्भहिया से देवी कित्तिमई लोयविक्खाया
english: A woman who is able to conceal her beauty with her senses, A goddess who is impermanent, Has destroyed the earth.

prakrit: तीय धूया सोहग्गरूवविण्णाणगारवग्धविया,पायालकन्नयसमा कणयवई नाम वरकन्ना
english: The fire is sweet, The fragrance is fragrant, The lamp is illuminated, And the bridegroom's name is Varakanna.

prakrit: सम्पत्तजोव्वणा सा आभरणविभूसिया पिउसयासे,पट्ठविया माऊए तदुचियवरदाणअट्ठाए
english: The youthful beauty of wealth is like a jeweler's son, Like a traveler's wife on his return home.

prakrit: आगम्म पायपडिया पिउणा सा सहरिसं निउच्छङ्गे,विणिवेसिय अवगụ̄धा भणिया य इमं तु सा कन्ना
english: Next time you step out for a drink You'd better take care of the town,"" said the monk, forgetting how busy he is. ""That's what you did.

prakrit: पुत्ति! नियहिययइट्ठं सामन्तमहन्तयाण मज्झम्मि,साहसु जेण तुहं सो किज्जइ भत्ता,किमन्नेणं?
english: Daughter! This is the land of feudal magnates, my lord. But what allowance do you make for being brave? How much?

prakrit: एवं पिउणा भणिया लज्जाए अहोमुही ठिया बाला,पुणरुत्तं पुट्ठावि हु न किञ्चि पडिउत्तरं देइ
english: And I am too shy to drink, And I stay still for the rest of the night. I will not answer you again.

prakrit: तो चिन्तिउं पयत्तो एया लज्जालुया इमा वरई,न हु सक्कइ वज्जरिउं एसो मह ताय! इट्ठॊत्ति
english: So think of me, you shy mother - in - law. Don't worry, you fool! It's just me!

prakrit: ता चिन्तेमि सयं चिय अणुरूवमिमीए पवरभत्तारं,विन्नाणरूवसम्पयकलियं वरवंसउप्पन्नं
english: I suppose you mean, my dear, That at the moment when I open my eyes I feel a rush of energy As if I'm about to open them.

prakrit: खणमेगमच्छिऊणं राया चिन्ताउरो भणइ तत्तो,पुत्ति! तुह रूवसरिसो भत्ता लद्धो मए इण्हिं
english: Don't worry, son, I'm not the only one who has this nasty habit. I've got it all for you.

prakrit: सिद्धत्थपुरे राया सुग्गीवो नाम मह परं मित्तं,तस्स तुमं गच्छ लहुं सयंवरा,एत्थ किं बहुणा?
english: In principle, please, I beg of you, My friend, There you go, Friend. What business is this of yours?

prakrit: एवं च भणियमेत्ते सा कन्ना देव! तुम्ह नामेण,निसुएणं चिय जाया हरिसवसुल्लसियरोमञ्चा
english: And he said,"" ""My god! In your name I beg of you To part with me As soon as I see you again.

prakrit: नाऊण तीए भावं राया सम्पेक्खिउण मह वयणं,वज्जरइ,तं महाबल! वच्चसु सिद्धत्थनयरम्मि
english: Now think of that girl Who, on touching my brother - in - law's cheek, Started to mutter:"" ""He's a big man!"" ""Once upon a time there was a man who could do anything.

prakrit: घेत्तुं सयंवरमिमं कणगवइं भूरिभूइसञ्जुत्तं,कइवयबलसञ्जुत्तो सोहणतिहिकरणनक्खतो
english: By embracing the lotus flower, The farmer gathers the first shoots of the plant, But by being forced to gather it, One does not achieve perfection.

prakrit: जं आणवेसि भणिउं तत्तो हं तं गहीय सञ्चलिओ,जाव य कमेण एत्तो जोयणमेत्तम्मि सम्पत्तो
english: As you say,"" ""I carry a heavy purse."" ""What makes a man so wealthy Is his youth.

prakrit: अज्ज रयणीविरामे कइवयतुरएहिं वेगवन्तेहिं,उग्गिलिय आगओ हुं तुम्हाण पियं निवेएमि
english: Today, on the night of the festival, I am so anxious to catch a glimpse of you That I take you for my lover.

prakrit: देव! महमेयमागमणकारणं पुच्छियं हि जं तुमए,एवं चवत्थियम्मि सम्पइ देवो पमाणन्ति
english: Deva! I beg of you the reason for my return. The gods agree on everything you say.

prakrit: हरिसाऊरियहियओ अह राया भणइ परियणं निययं,महया विच्छड्डेणं नयरे कन्नं पवेसेह
english: Aunt, It's fair to say that love is destined to last, Like the bee that pierces one's ear Before it pierces it.

prakrit: तो परियणेण सम्मं तहत्ति सम्पाडियम्मि वयणम्मि,सोहणलग्गे रन्ना परिणीया तत्थ कणगवई
english: So till you reach your destination, sampadyammy vayanammy, Sohanlagge, run, Parinaya, That's how the villagers behave.

prakrit: सा रन्नो कणगवई कालेण अईव वल्लहा जाया,मह माऊए ठाणे विहिया अह पट्टबद्धा सा
english: She runs away, When the rainy season is over, My mother - in - law has left, And now I am bound to her.

prakrit: अइवल्लहम्पि वीसरइ माणूसं देसकालअन्तरियं,वल्लीसमं हि पिम्मं जं आसन्नं तहिं चडइ
english: A vaillahampi wanders the interior of a man's day, But the vaallisam climbs the next moment it is near.

prakrit: वच्चन्ति वासराइं मह पिउणो तीए गाढरत्तस्स,सịधिलीकयसेसोरोहरमणिगमणाइचेट्ठस्स
english: The calf is coming to drink from me, That dark night, When all the lotuses in the house Are staring at me.

prakrit: अह अन्नया कयाइवि कणगवईए सुओ समुप्पन्नो,सुरहॊत्ति विहियनामो पत्तो सो कुमरभावम्मि
english: Oh, my! There must be something wrong with that girl. Tell me, is it the nature of virginity That causes such a thing to happen?

prakrit: अन्नदियहम्मि एयं एगन्ते भणइ कणगवई देवी,जुवरायपए किं नवि अहिसिच्चइ देव! मे पुत्तो
english: Mother - in - law! It is the goddess of grains who speaks first. In the guise of jujurors What a new god! My son!

prakrit: तो भणइ नरवरिन्दो जेट्ठे पुत्तम्मि सुप्पइट्ठम्मि,विज्जन्ते न हु जुत्तं जुवरायं ठाविउं सुरहं
english: So he says,"" ""A man sleeps where his daughter sleeps, But wisdom does not allow him to sleep where his wife sleeps.

prakrit: भणियं देवीए तओ जेट्ठट्ठवणे निहोडउ को णु?,जइ तुज्झ अहं दइया ता सुरहं कुणसु जुयरायं
english: Daughter - in - law, Who will keep you awake? If I give it to you, How can I know for sure?

prakrit: ताहे रन्ना भणियं सुट्ठुं पिया तं सुलोयणे! मज्झ,किन्तु इमस्स 'णुरत्ता सामन्तमहन्तया सव्वे
english: Well, you lie awake and drink! It's my fault, but my lord, All these gentlemen are feudal lords.

prakrit: तह एसो सुसमत्थो एवं विहिए विहेज्ज तं किम्पि,अवमाणिओ हु जेणं ममावि रज्जं अवहरेज्जा
english: So let's keep it simple and discrete. For those who disobey me Will find it difficult to avoid the ropes of love.

prakrit: तो भणइ हसिय देवी एरिससत्तेण कह तुमं विहिणा,पिययम! राया विहिओ नवरि किराडो कओ हॊन्तो?
english: So the laughing goddess Eris Satane tells me you are engaged, my dear! How can a bridegroom be married while her husband is away?

prakrit: जेणेव सुप्पइट्ठो एरिसओ उक्कडो पयावेण,तेणेव इमं सिग्घं कट्ठहरे खिवसु जत्तेण
english: One who has slept soundly, Like a traveler on a yoke, Will soon find one who has run out of straw.

prakrit: तत्तो य मज्झ पुत्तं जुवरायं ठाविउं पयत्तेण,अच्छसु विगयासङ्को रज्जं च ममं च माणन्तो
english: So please, my son, don't treat me like a criminal. I will treat you like one if you treat me with courtesy.

prakrit: एवं देवीवयणं सोउं पडिउत्तरं अदाऊणं,राया समुट्ठिऊणं अत्थाणे गन्तुमुवविट्ठो
english: And the goddess said,"" ""One day you will have to answer, And when he has finished telling the story You will soon be on your way.

prakrit: एयं च देविवयणं सूहवियानामियाए चेडीए,पच्छन्ने सोऊणं सव्वं धणदेव! मह सिट्ठं
english: This is the place where the gods sleep, And in the middle of the night they sleep: They are all gods of wealth!

prakrit: तं सोउं मह विगप्पो चित्ते एयारिसो समुप्पन्नो,किं कणगवईए वुत्तो करेज्ज एवं पिया मज्झ?
english: I suppose you'd rather sleep than think about it, my dear. What makes you think I'd like it and drink it?

prakrit: अहवा न गणन्ति पुव्वनेहं न य नीइं नेय लोयअववायं,न य भाविआवयाओ पुरिसा महिलाण आयत्ता
english: Ahava does not count men, You do not take women into account, Nor do men count women into the future.

prakrit: ता जा न किम्पि अन्नं देवीवयणाओ मह पिया कुणइ,ताव अहिट्ठेमि सयं रज्जं,पियरं विणासेत्ता
english: Then why don't you go and buy some food, Say what you like, Then I'll join you on the raft, To weave a weave of pearls.

prakrit: अहव न एयं जुत्तं विवेयजुत्तस्स मज्झ काउं जे,ता बन्धिऊण पियरं कट्ठहरगयं अणुचरामि
english: Ah! there is nothing more to be said for it Than that I am so discerning That I repeat it over and over again.

prakrit: किंवा कणगवइं चिय सह सुरहेणं नयामि जमवयणे,किंवा कट्ठहरम्मि दोन्निवि घेत्तेमि बन्धउं?
english: Or should I arrange for my husband to join me on the pyre, or should I tie the two hands together on the rafters?

prakrit: अहवा किं मह इमिणा पेक्खामो ताव जं पिया कुणइ,अदिट्ठपाणियम्मि न हु जुत्तं पाणहुम्मुयणं
english: Ahava, why should I care what your lover says About you If you don't want to be touched by water?

prakrit: अह राया मह उवरिं दिणे दिणे पिययमाए भन्नन्तो,जाओ सịधिलसिणेहो कन्नविसं जं महन्तविसं
english: Ah, the days of my husband's marriage Are long past,"" said the beloved. ""Go, follow me, my poor girl, For I have a husband who is a great man.

prakrit: सहसत्ति अन्नदियहे किम्पि मिसं दाविऊण मह रन्ना,हरियं गामसहस्सं दिन्नं लहुखेडयं एक्कं
english: A hundred and seventy grains of rice Are enough to satisfy my thirst. The only thing that gives me pleasure in village life Is the paddy field.

prakrit: सञ्जायअमरिसेणं ताहे मए चिन्तियं दुरायारं,मारेऊण एयं रज्जमहिट्ठेमि,किं बहुणा?
english: Sanjay, you fool, I am thinking of the misfortune of being away. I will arrange for you to be killed. What do you think?

prakrit: अहवा न पुव्वपुरिसेहिं मज्झं वंसे कयं इमं पावं,तमहम्पि कह करोमी असाररज्जस्स कज्जेण?
english: Ahava, why should I suffer the same fate As your husband? Tell me, am I to blame for a heart that has failed me?

prakrit: महिलावयणेण इमो रागन्धो कुणइ,कुणउ अन्नायं,मह पुण विवेयजुत्तस्स हन्दि! न हु एरिसं जुत्तं
english: With a woman's voice heals my anger, Restores my modesty, And restores my good sense. There is nothing wrong with that.

prakrit: ता किं करेमि इण्हिं अवमाणं ताव दूसहं पिउणो,अप्पवहोवि न जुत्तो देसच्चाओ परं जुत्तो
english: What am I to do, then, If you treat me with such disrespect As if I were your enemy And drink your wine?

prakrit: गन्तूणमन्नदेसं तम्हा सेवामि अन्ननरनाहं,हुं तम्पि हु नहु जुत्तं अवमाणपयं हि सेवत्ति
english: I will not eat bread to serve you in this wretched country; I will serve you only if I am not dishonoured.

prakrit: सुग्गीवनरिन्दसुओ जुयराया आसि एस रिद्धिजुओ,सम्पइ पुण वण्ठोइव कह सेवं कुणइ भिच्चाण?
english: Are you a good man or a poor man, Young man or woman, How can a monk render such service When he has reached the pinnacle of perfection?

prakrit: एमाइवयणवित्थरवज्जरणसमुज्जएण लोएणं,दंसिज्जन्तो रिऊण कहं गेहेसुं परिभमिस्सं?
english: How can I describe my family, Which is so fragrant, Like a river in spate?

prakrit: तम्हा कइवयनियपुरिसपरिगओ अकयअन्नजणसेवो,गन्तुं चिट्ठामि अहं कम्मिवि पच्चन्तदेसम्मि
english: I am going to write you a letter,"" he said, ""In the service of another man, To whom I owe a debt of gratitude.

prakrit: जा जीवइ एस पिया एयम्मि मयम्मि पुण जहा जुत्तं,तइय च्चिय काहामो किं इण्हिं तीए चिन्ताए?
english: As long as I live, my darling, my son, what is there for me to worry about?

prakrit: एवं विणिच्छियमई कइवयपियपरियणेण परियरिओ,सामन्तमन्तिपुरनायगेहिं रन्ना य अन्नाओ
english: And wretched people fall in love with strangers, And the landowner's son makes a run for his money.

prakrit: नीहरिओ तत्तो हं कमेण अह पाविउं इमं पल्लिं,सीहगुहं नामेण अच्छिउमेईए पारद्धं
english: The water is blue, So what can I do about it? I've gotta put it in my pocket, My eyes are watery, And I have a secret secret.

prakrit: मिलिया मज्झ अणेगे भिल्ला चोरा कुकम्मनिरया य,तेहिं परिवारिओ हं सम्पइ पल्लीवई जाओ
english: Miliya mujhe aanege, bhilla chora, kumkumna niraya, there's the whole family. Let's go to the village fair.

prakrit: तं जं तुमए पुट्ठं तुम्हाणं कह णु एत्थ आवासो,उत्तमनराण पाविट्ठलोयजोगाए पल्लीए?
english: How is it that you, my son, tell me you live here, Mr. Village, That you grew up with such good intentions?

prakrit: एयं सङ्खेवेणं कहियमवत्थाणकारणं एत्थ,तं तुह धणदेव! मए गरुयसिणेहेण सव्वम्पि
english: Tell me, What makes you so angry? It's your god! I've got everything to do with my pride.

prakrit: भणियं धणदेवेणं अव्वो! जणओपि एरिसं कुणइ,अवमाणं पुत्ताणं धी! धी! संसारवासस्स
english: Friend, give me the weapon! Anyone can do this. Please, my son, stay safe! Stay safe! The rest of the world.

prakrit: सॊ च्चिय कज्जवसेणं वल्लहओ होइ एत्थ संसारे,कारणवसेण सोवि हु रिउव्व वेसो जणो होइ
english: May he be dear to this world, dear to it, and may I always be so, for he is dear to me.

prakrit: परमत्थओ न कोवि हु पिओ व सत्तू व अत्थि लोगम्मि,नइ माया नेय पिया सकज्जवसओ जणो सव्वो
english: In the world there is no love greater than affection, No one is dearer than oneself, Nor can anyone love than one's neighbor.

prakrit: पुत्तोवि सत्तुसरिसो दीसइ नियकारणे अपुज्जन्ते,पिउणा सुविणीओवि हु धिरत्थु संसारवासस्स
english: A wise woman drinks wine, But when her husband returns he cannot, For he is busy with other things in the world.

prakrit: तं चिय कुमार! महप्पा तं चिय पसमस्स लद्धपरमत्थो,तं चिय विवेयजुत्तो तुमऎ च्चिय मण्डिया वसुहा
english: That is my boy! My boy, That is your passion and your belief in yourself. In your wisdom you have proved a blessing.

prakrit: पिउणा 'वमाणिओवि हु अन्नं असमञ्जसं अकाऊणं,सन्तम्मि बले तहवि हु देसच्चाओ कओ जेण
english: To drink,"" said the woman, ""To eat, To muddle the dish."" Saying so with satisfaction, ""There must be something else going on.

prakrit: एमाइवयणवित्थरअवरोप्परवड्ढमाणनेहाणं,ताणं पञ्च व सत्त व वोलीणा वासरा जाव
english: A man is born who grows taller and wider, has five and seven limbs, and can walk on either side of the head.

prakrit: तावय समत्थसत्थं दठ्ठूणं गमणउच्छुगीभूयं,धणदेवो आपुच्छइ गमणत्थं सुप्पइट्ठं तं
english: You will see with your right eye That the bow is about to fall, But the God of Love wants you to fall asleep in your bow.

prakrit: तुम्ह विओगो दूसहो एसो सत्थो समुच्छुगीभूओ,तं कुमारो! अम्ह जायं एत्थ तडी एत्थ वग्घॊत्ति
english: You fool, It's just the way you behave, My boy! Wherever I am, There's a flock of wolves Here.

prakrit: एएणं चिय नेच्छन्ति साहवो सज्जणेहिं संसग्गिं,जम्हा विओगविहुरियहिययस्स न ओसहं अन्नं
english: They do not like to be with other gentlemen, For there is no food for them When they are busy making love.

prakrit: जहवि हु वहइ न जीहा एरिसवयणे समुल्लविज्जन्ते,तहवि हु भणामि मुञ्चसु गच्छामो सम्पयं अम्हे
english: As long as I am not distracted by gossip or gossip, I think I've got it all.

prakrit: ता किम्पि चिन्तिऊणं खणन्तरं दीहर च नीससिउं,वज्जरइ सुप्पइट्ठो सविसायं एरिसं वयणं
english: Then why think of it at all? It takes a long time to get used to it. It's like going to bed early, And waking up late at night?

prakrit: अम्हारिसेहिं गिहमागयाण तुम्हारिसाणं सुयणाणं,को उवयारो कीरउ एरिसठाणे वसन्तेहिं?
english: I suppose you'd better take it easy, my dear: Who would you rather be living with in this place?

prakrit: तहवि हु भणामि किञ्चिवि कायव्वो नेव पत्थणाभङ्गो,जेण परकज्जसाहणनिरया खलु सज्जणा हॊन्ति
english: Even so, I suppose, Anyone who does anything But break a stone Is a good gentleman if he shows it kindness.

prakrit: तत्तो फुरन्तनिम्मलम ऊहविच्छु रियदसदिसा ' 'भोगो,एक्कोवि अणेगगुणो पवरमणी तस्स उवणीओ
english: There you are, sighing, Calmly imagining your long - awaited destination."" ""Enjoy it! Only a virtuous woman with innumerable virtues Can make you happy.

prakrit: दट्ठुं दिव्वमणिं तं दीसन्ताणेयलक्खणं विमलं,वियसियलोयणजुअलो अह धणदेवो इमं भणइ
english: When he sees her, The lamp burns bright, And when he looks at her He says:"" ""Here is the God of Love.

prakrit: एरिसपवरमणीणं मणुस्सखेत्तम्मि सम्भवो नत्थि,नवरं जइ सुरलोगे हवेज्ज न हु अन्नखेत्तम्मि
english: It is not possible for a man to cultivate a field on account of its abundant water resources. But if one does, one cannot cultivate food on its own.

prakrit: एवं विणिच्छियम्मिवि तहवि हु कोऊहलं महं हियए,तो भणसु कह णु जाया सम्पत्ती तुम्ह एयस्स?
english: And tell me, you silly girl, If I tell you the truth, Where have you got all this wealth?

prakrit: तो भणइ सुप्पइट्ठो सम्मं हि विणिच्छियं तुमे भद्द!,माणुसखेत्तसमुत्थो न होइ एसो मणी ताव
english: So tell me, you scoundrel!"" he said, ""As long as you sleep well, don't trouble yourself with people. This is the mani tava.

prakrit: किन्तु सुरलोगजाओ एसो सम्पाविओ जहम्हेहिं,तं एगमणो होउ जइ कोउगमत्थि तो सुणसु
english: But listen, lover: This is the way things should be, If you want to hear what's going on.

prakrit: पुव्वं एगम्मि दिणे पभायसमयम्मि गहियकोदण्डा,चलिओ कइवयनियपुरिसपरिगओ मिगवहट्ठाए
english: Tomorrow morning,"" said the girl, ""the first day of the festival will be dark. So let's go and see how the women behave Before the men.

english: The face of the north is like the lotus on the ground, Like a thicket of reeds I am weary.

english: Ah! What do you mean, my dear? You're so angry! Get up now! This separation from you won't save my life.

english: After all, no one deserves to be treated with such harshness, so how can I help you?

english: This is my favorite part of the story: I'm telling you so, my dear. But listen, dear girl, It's me speaking for you.

english: And oh, good god! So tell me, son - in - law, When was the last time you said a word to your daughter?

english: Ah, dear girl, Why are you staring at me all the time? It's obvious you're scared of someone Who might come along And whose business it is!

english: The churning of the ocean of samsara is perilous! Life must go on, Not the thunderclap of fire Or the thunderbolt of inanimate creation.

english: All sorrow must be destroyed by pure reason; all virtue must be renounced for the sake of virtue.

english: Foolish girl, Don't be so naïve: The fragrant flowers of the God of Love are scattered all over the place"" ""is the refrain of a popular song.

prakrit: अविय वायन्तमलयमारुयचलन्तपत्तलविसालसाहाहिं,नच्चन्तिव तरुणो पहरिसेण महुमासआगमणे
english: Awesome young man, Watching the arrival of the monsoons, Like a mermaid hovering over a withering lotus.

prakrit: कुसुमा ' 'मोया ' 'यड̣धियअलिउलझङ्कारगहिरसद्देण,गायन्तिव तरुनियरा वसन्तमासागमे तुट्ठा
english: Kusuma's"" ""Moya"" ""with its thunderous clap of thunder, The singing of young men, Slipping off in the heat of spring

prakrit: मयरन्दपिञ्जराओ विसट्टसुगन्धकुसुमवयणाओ,वणराईओ हसन्तिव वसन्तमासागमं दट्ठुं
english: Bees sigh, bees groan, The foresters laugh, And behold the arrival of spring.

prakrit: दट्ठूणव तरुनियरं महुसमए बहलपत्तलच्छायं,अवमाणिओ पलासो कसिणमुहो झत्ति सञ्जाओ
english: When young men see the moonlit expanse of a broad sheet, They blush in humiliation, But when a cousin appears They are sure to be struck by lightning.

prakrit: अच्छउ ता फलकाले फुल्लिमंसमएवि कालिमा वयणे,इय कलिउंव पलासो चत्तो पत्तेहिं किविणोव्व
english: Well then, tell me, When the flowers are ripe And the pods black, It's only the tip of the bud That kills the leaf.

prakrit: दट्ठूण वणसमिद्धिं पलासविडवेहिं मउलियं वयणं,अन्नेवि हु अप्पत्ता पररिद्धिं नेय विसहन्ति
english: When you look at the forest, You can see the grass on the ground, And when you look down the road you can see it all.

prakrit: अविय पावियवसन्तमासो वणम्मि निस्सेसपीयलोहियओ,पियविरहियपहियाणं भयजणओ किंसुयपिसाओ
english: You silly girl, Are you afraid you'll fall in love With someone you don't know? Anybody who is afraid of falling in love Will regret it.

prakrit: अन्नं च पञ्चसरलोद्धएणं महुमासबिइज्जएण दयरहियं,हम्मन्तीओ गाढं दट्ठूणव पहियमहिलाओ
english: Food and drink should be given to the fivefolded lotus flower, For it is the wife who gives milk to the sage.

prakrit: हसियंव मज्झसण्ठियकलयण्ठिकएण कूइयरवेण,पयडियमञ्जरिगुरुदन्तपन्तियं चूयविडवेहिं
english: Laughing at the gooseflesh hovering over my waist, Payyadeemanjari gurudantepantiyum chuyvideweyhim.

prakrit: दट्ठूण पहियनिवहं निहयं महुमासलोद्धयनरेण,ओणयमुहीओ कुसुमंसुएहिं रोयन्तिव लयाओ
english: Look at that lovely woman Whose face is smeared with bees, Crying with the fragrance of kisses.

prakrit: मयपहियाण जलन्तिव ठाणे ठाणे महन्तचीयाओ,घणकिंसुयच्छलेणं अलिरवमिसिमिसियसद्दाओ
english: Maypahyan Jalantiv Thane Mahantachiyao, Ghanakinke Suyachalan Alirvamisimiciousadhao

prakrit: निज्झरतडेसु तरुणो पवणपहल्लन्तजलनिबुड्डेहिं,साहाकरेहिं देन्तिव जलञ्जलिं जत्थ पहियाणं
english: In the spring the young man steps in front of a cascade of rippling water, Helping the traveler carry the torrent with him.

prakrit: किञ्च घणकिंसुयनवरङ्गयविराइया बद्धपवरमयणहला,पाडलकुसुमा सोहई वसन्तलच्छी नववहुव्व
english: Some lovely girl, Pretending to be pregnant With a fresh pair of bangles, Lovely girl, Spring is on the horizon, So is the new bride.

prakrit: अन्नं च बुहसहिओवि हु सूरो कव्वसत्तो वसन्तमाहप्पा,उवभुञ्जिऊण मीणं सम्पइ मेसस्स उक्कॊत्ति
english: There's a lot of sunshine And the moon looks like a lotus, But when you touch it with your finger It wipes away the whole mess.

prakrit: ता एरिसे वसन्ते दिसिदिसिपसरन्तपरहुयासद्दे,वित्थरियचच्चरीरवमुहरियउज्जाणभूभागे
english: There is a spring in the sky, Running from day to day, Like the earth churning with the rays of the sun.

prakrit: विलसन्ति कामुयजणा अन्दोलिज्जन्ति तरुणजुवईओ,वित्थरइ पडहयरवो पियन्ति वरवारुणिं तरुणा
english: Delighted are the young men who yearn for pleasure, And the young women who grovel for pleasure.

prakrit: साहीणपिययमाणं तरुणीणं वल्लहम्मि महुमासे,धम्मपरायणलोएण एत्थ कीरन्ति जत्ताओ
english: A swarm of bees is at hand, Like a young bridegroom At the time of her wedding. So gather the creepers here, Like people who follow the dharma.

prakrit: जिणबिम्बाणं भत्तीए तेण एए समागया देवा,सव्वायरेण वेयड्ढसिद्धकूडेसु जत्तत्थं
english: As long as you worship him, O God of Love, May he guide you all the way.

prakrit: तत्तो य मए भणियं जइ एवं तो वयंस! अम्हेवि,गन्तूण सिद्धकूडे सासयसव्वन्नुपडिमाओ
english: Well, my brother - in - law will come, and so will we! My dear, There must be a way.

prakrit: भत्तीए पणमिऊणं करेसु नियमाणुसत्तणं सहलं,पेच्छामो जिणजत्तं सुयखयरोहेण किज्जन्तं
english: I will put up with it, my dear, As long as I abide by the rules Of etiquette. But how can I live a happy life If I refuse to bow down?

prakrit: अह सव्वेहिवि भणियं एवं होउत्ति सुट्ठु ते भणियं,एत्थन्तरम्मि पत्तो मह धाइसुओ बलो नाम
english: Oh! everyone! My brother - in - law and wife are sleeping soundly. Tell me, my poor girl, The path from here to there.

prakrit: आगम्म तेम भणियं पिउणा ते चित्तवेग! संलत्तं,एसो हु रयणसञ्चयवत्थव्वो सयलखयरजणो
english: Come, let us eat and drink together, That is the way of mind!"" ""Here I am,"" ""says the wise man,"" Steady as a log.

prakrit: न्हाओ विलित्तदेहो सुहनेवत्थो महाविभूईए,चलिओ जिणजत्ताए आसन्ने सिद्धकूडम्मि
english: Be not dismayed: With pleasure and glory be yours; For the victory is sure to come At the right time.

prakrit: तेण समं अम्हेवि हु चलिया ता सिग्घमेव आगच्छ,कयण्हाणाइविहाणा जेण समं चेव गच्छामो
english: As fast as we walk, So slowly do we come; As slow as a bridegroom's pace, So fast do we go.

prakrit: तव्वयणं सोऊणं नियगेहे आगओ पिउसमीवे,तेवि य मज्झ वयंसा नियनियगेहेसु सम्पत्ता
english: If you want to sleep peacefully At the same time as your husband, You have to live peacefully.

prakrit: कयण्हाणाइविहाणो सह पिउणा ताहे पवणगइणा हं,तक्कालुचियं सव्वं गहिऊणं धूवपुप्फाइं
english: To drink with a spiteful widow Is like sharing a meal with her lover. Everything you want to eat You have to wash with soap.

prakrit: नागरजणेण सहिओ उप्पइओ खग्गसामलं गयणं,गच्छन्तेण कमेणं दिट्ठं भवणं जिणिन्दस्स
english: Friend, you have to sing the Kṛṣṇa's name aloud, To go and see what is to be done Is to conquer the world.

prakrit: वायन्तमउयमारुयमन्दन्दोलन्तधयवडगेहिं,सन्नंव करेमाणं आगमणत्थं जणोहस्स
english: Vayantama, yama ̄ ya ̄ maruma ̄ mi ̄, mandala ̄ n ̣ a, dhyavada ̄ geya, sannamma ̄ ma ̄ rya karema, a ̄ gamana ̄ tha janohasa.

prakrit: दुन्दुहिमउन्दमद्दलतिलिमापमुहेण तूरसद्देण,हक्कारन्तेव जणं जत्तासमए जिणिन्दस्स
english: A man who stares at you, Who turns his face away, With tears streaming down his face, Has a good life in this world.

prakrit: तत्तो कमेण पत्ता दिसि दिसि नच्चन्तअच्छरानियरं,मणहरगेयझुणीए आणन्दियभवियसन्दोहं
english: So give me the lotus leaf That does not stick to the nail mark. I will punish you for it If you refuse to bend it As long as you do.

prakrit: नाणाविहवत्थेहिं कयउल्लोयं मणोहरायारं,विच्छित्तीए लम्बियनिम्मलवरहारओचूलं
english: Like a coin tossed from the rafters, Like a garland of pearls plucked from a scorpion's beak,

prakrit: विरइयघणफुल्लहरं विचित्तलम्बन्ततारियाइन्नं,पवरपडिमण्डवेणं उच्छाइयअङ्गणाभोयं
english: A lonely flock of birds Is scattered all over the place, Like a banner proclaiming the birth of a god.

prakrit: नीसलतड्डियचन्दायएहिं मण्डियचउक्कियादेसं,फुल्लमयपवरतोरणसोहियमज्झं जिणिन्दगिहं
english: O moonlit night, Like the bustle of a crescent moon, I will conquer the jingling waters of the God of Love.

prakrit: तस्स य दुवारदेसे निम्मलजलपूरियाए वावीए,काउण पायसोयं निययवयंसेहिं परिवरिओ
english: When he offers her a bowl of neem water at the doorstep, She says:"" ""Please, please, go home as usual.

prakrit: जिणभवणदुवारट्ठियउच्चल्लियफुल्लमालियोहस्स,पुप्फाइं गेण्हन्तो अन्तो विहिणा पविट्ठो हं
english: A lotus blooms on the roof of your house, You fool, If you want to kiss a woman's cheek I am bound to fall.

prakrit: पूइय जिणिन्दबिम्बे काउं चीइवन्दणं जहाविहिणा,बाहिं नीहरिओ हं उवविट्ठो खयरमज्झम्मि
english: Wretched soul, How strange it is to see a woman's face reflected in a mirror, Like a cloud rising from the sky.

prakrit: वत्ते जिणमज्जणए इओ तओ तत्थ सञ्चरन्तो हं,अवरोप्परदंसियकोउगेहिं सहिओ वयंसेहिं
english: By the way, man, I'm just passing by. For looking down the road You'd better bear with me.

prakrit: कत्थइ विलासिणिजणं पेच्छन्तो नच्चमाणयं विविहं,कत्थइ कविवरनिवहं जिणचरियं अहिणवेमाणं
english: How many luxuries does a person enjoy, How many different kinds of nasty things does a poet enjoy, And how many lifetimes do we waste in idleness?

prakrit: वीणारवसंवलियं कत्थवि गीयज्झुणिं निसामेन्तो,विरइयविविहायारं कत्थवि य बलिं पलोएन्तो
english: The plucked strings of the lute quench the thud of the lyre, And the disjointed strings perform the sacrifice.

prakrit: कत्थइ तरुणनरेहिं दिज्जन्तं रासयं सुणेमाणो,सुरसुन्दरीहिं कत्थइ गिज्जन्तं धवलसङ्घायं
english: How much youth does a woman need To hear a melody, How much love does a beautiful woman need to hear a clap of thunder?

prakrit: एवं च जाव कोऊहलेण अवरावरेसु ठाणेसु,हिण्डामि तत्थ भवणे लीलाए समं वयंसेहिं
english: And go away, my boy,"" said the traveler, ""I will stay there with you for a while. At the same time I will visit you at your house in Leela.

prakrit: ताव मह माउलसुओ सहरिसमागम्म साइयं दाउं,वज्जरइ भाणुवेगो पभूयकालाओ दिट्ठो सि
english: So let me tell you, my poor boy, That while the sun is still shining I see the moonlight of the sky.

prakrit: कुसलं च पवणगइणो पिउभगिणीए य बउलवइयाए?,तत्तो य मए भणियं कुसलं सव्वेसि,अन्नं च
english: Where are you going? Are you going to tell me what to eat?"" he asked his wife, ""And when will you come home?

prakrit: एत्थेव आगयाइ इमाइं चिट्ठन्ति भद्द! जिणभवणे,अम्मापिऊण मूलं समागओ तेण सहिओ हं
english: That's the way it is! Your mother scolded you for coming here. Please, my dear, bear with me as I made love.

prakrit: सायरमवगụ̄धो सो तेहिं पउत्तिं च पुच्छिओ भणइ,कुसलं मह जणगाणं नागमणं कारणावेक्खं
english: When he comes home in the evening, He asks him what he wants from his daughter - in - law."" ""Tomorrow I'll have to explain why I hate my husband.

prakrit: अह सो मए पभणिओ वित्तप्पाया इमा हु जिणजत्ता,सम्पइ पुण अम्हाणं आगच्छसु पाहुणो ताव
english: Ah, so I have to spend the rest of my life with you, my dear. I will always be your guest.

prakrit: तो भणइ भाणुवेगो एवं एयन्ति किन्तु निसुणेसु,मह चित्तभाणुपिउणा लहुमागच्छेज्ज इति भणियं
english: So I said,'Go ahead and do it, but be patient; I think I've got a lot of catching up to do.

prakrit: ता चित्तवेग! सम्पइ तं चिय नगरम्मि एहि महतणए,उक्कण्ठिओ पगामं जं अच्छइ तुम्ह माउलओ
english: That's the mood! It's just the way you live in town. Wait a minute, you stupid bastard.

prakrit: एवं च तेण भणिओ अम्मापीईहिं अब्भणुन्नाओ,भाउसमेओ पत्तो नगरमहं कुञ्जरावत्तं
english: And he said,"" ""You fool, you fool, The path leads to the town of Kunjaravatta.

prakrit: तहिंय च चित्तभाणू मं दट्ठूं सुट्ठु हरिसिओ भणइ,सुन्दरमायरियं ते जमागओ अम्ह पाहुणओ
english: You look at me with such fondness, You turn your back on me, And tell me, darling, How lovely it is To be welcomed by my guests.

prakrit: निययपउत्तिं सव्वं कहिउं कयभोयणाइवावारो,पत्ताए रयणीए पासुत्तो पवरसयणीए
english: I'll tell you the whole story in due course: The traveler leaves, And the traveler follows.

prakrit: तत्थ य पभायसमए लवमाणे तम्बचूलनिउरम्बे,दिट्ठो अदिट्ठपुव्वो एसो सुमिणो मए तइया
english: At that moment I looked at you with such fondness, As if I were a traveler's son.

prakrit: किल धवलफुल्लमालं मणोहरं दट्ठु तग्गहट्ठाए,चलिओ हं न य सक्केमि गेण्हिउं तं जया कहवि
english: Please, tell that girl Jaya, Who after a long search Has reduced the size of her eyes to mere petals, Will not be able to walk again.

prakrit: केणवि मित्तेण तओ समप्पिया आयरेण मे गहिया,ओलम्बिस्सं गलए किल नियए ताव सा झत्ति
english: Have you ever smelt iron with a friend's milk? It's as if you've tried to kill an Olympian.

prakrit: पडिया मह हत्थाओ कत्थवि य गयत्ति नेय जाणामि,ताहे महन्तदुक्खं तव्विरहे मज्झ सञ्जायं
english: Believe me, I know how to tell a story, But my heart aches And my heart sighs for you.

prakrit: सुक्कावि मए एसा पुणोवि अमिलाणकुसुमिया विहिया,इय भणिऊणं केणवि कण्ठे विणिवेसिया मज्झ
english: I will never forget how, when I was dry, The fragrant jasmine bloomed again, Saying this:"" ""My heart swoons at the sound of someone's voice.

prakrit: ताव पडुपटहझल्लरिकाहलभम्भामउन्दसद्दालं,सोउं तूरस्स रवं झत्ति पणट्ठा महं निद्दा
english: There you are, Standing on the bank of the river, Sucking in the cool breeze As if it were a waterfall.

prakrit: तो हरिसविसायड्ढं दट्ठुं सुमिणं विचिन्तियं हियए,किं नाम मज्झ सूयइ अदिट्ठपुव्वं इमं सुमिणं?
english: So look around you, tell me, What is your name, my sleepy self, That I sleep without seeing you?

prakrit: का हन्दि! इमा माला विज्जा व सम्पया व मह होज्जा,दिन्ना केणवि नट्ठा पुणरवि लद्धा,न याणामि
english: Whose hand is it? This garland of jasmine, Wrapped in a blanket, Is my master's ornament. No one has ever plundered it But me.

prakrit: एवं अणिच्छियत्थो सुविणसरूवस्स उट्ठिओ अहयं,काउं पभायकिच्चं अह सहिओ भाणुवेगेण
english: And suddenly, with a goodly sigh, I rose to my feet. But for some reason, my friends muttered,"" ""I'm off.

prakrit: आरụ̄धो पासाए उवरिमभूमीए चित्तसालाए,मणिरयणकोट्टिमम्मी उवविट्ठो मत्तवारणए
english: And now that you've passed by, Your mind is absorbed in the earth, Like a drunkard climbing up and down the steps of a manirayan kotty.

prakrit: अह तं पभायदिट्ठं सिट्ठं सुविणं तु भाणुवेगस्स,निच्छइउं नो सक्कइ सोवि हु सुविणस्स सब्भावं
english: Ah, the beauty of your face, You silly girl, Don't be so naïve As to think you're a gentleman.

prakrit: चिन्तित्ता सुविणफलं विगप्पसङ्कप्पखित्तनियचित्ता,जा चिट्ठामो अम्हे खणन्तरं तत्थ ठाणम्मि
english: Thinking is the fruit of good thoughts And thinking is the enemy of bad thoughts. The letter we write Staying there for a while.

prakrit: मयलञ्छणपवणेणं गाढं सन्धुक्किओ विओयग्गी,सन्ताविउं पयत्तो मह हिययं ताहे सयगुणियं
english: If you want to enjoy your love, You'd better stop, For if you're afraid of being angry You'll get the better of me.

prakrit: अह चिन्तिउं पयत्तो अमयमओ सुम्मई इमो चन्दो,नवरं तव्विरहे अज्ज विज्जुपुञ्जोवमो जाओ
english: Ah! the moon is silent, Oh! think of me! It's the waning moon That gives birth to your son - in - law.

prakrit: हे हियय! कीस उज्झसि उव्वेयं कीस कुणसि अच्चत्थं?,दुल्लहजणम्मि रागं पढमं चिय कीस तं कुणसि?
english: Hey! How come you are so loud? What do you mean you are talking nonsense? Why do you talk like a fool When you have to recite a familiar tune?

prakrit: अन्नं च जो किर करेइ नेहं तस्सेव य हियय! रच्चिउं जुत्तं,दूरट्ठिओवि जो दहइ माणसं तम्मि को रागो?
english: What can I do for you, my dear, If you won't do as I tell you! How can a burning man be angry when you burn him at a distance While he is busy cooking?

prakrit: सॊ च्चिय वुब्भइ हियए सॊ च्चिय अइनिट्ठुरो दहइ देहं,कस्स कहिज्जइ वत्ता सरणाओ भयम्मि उब्भूए?
english: Whom do you think you are looking for? Your body is burning so stubbornly. Who is going to tell you what to do?

prakrit: किं मन्ने होज्ज दियहं जम्मी लग्गेज्ज मज्झ हत्थम्मि,मणनिव्ववणो तीए कमलोयरकोमलो हत्थो
english: What do you mean it's my hand that's clutching at your waist, Not my husband's?

prakrit: अच्छउ ता दूरॆ च्चिय पाणिग्गहणाइयं तु सह तीए,अम्हाण मणोदइयं दंसणमवि दुल्लहं मन्ने
english: Well, you're a long way off, honey, and I'd love to hang out with you.

prakrit: किं मज्झ जीविएणं किंवा मह हन्दि! मणुयजम्मेण,जो विरहदुक्खसमणं तीए वयणं न पेच्छामि?
english: Should I live, or should I die? For what use is a human being if he cannot bear to suffer the pain of separation?

prakrit: अहवा चूयलयाए भणिएणं भविस्सई पभायम्मि,तीए सह दंसणयं अणुकूलो जइ विही होही
english: Ahava Chulyayya said,"" ""Mother - in - law, if you want to be with her, you have to bow down.

prakrit: गुरुविरहजलणजालावलीहिं सन्तावियस्स हिययस्स,अन्नो नत्थि उवाओ पियदंसणओसहं मोत्तुं
english: The sage was so distracted by the stream of tears streaming down his face That he could not help but sigh at the sight of his beloved.

prakrit: एमाइविगप्पेहिं पणट्ठणिद्दस्स मज्झ सा रयणी,चउजामावि हु तइया जामसहस्सोवमा जाया
english: My dear, You are so stubborn, my dear, That even after four nights You do not want to be angry.

prakrit: असरिसदूसहसन्तावतावियं कहवि माणसं मज्झ,फुडमाणम्पि न फुट्टं मन्ने तद्दंसणासाए
english: Tell me, I beg of you, How can a man be so touchy When he has no more food than he needs to eat?

prakrit: सीयलकरनियरेणवि सन्तावं फेडिउं मह असत्तो,अह लज्जिउव्व चन्दो अत्थगिरिं पाविओ तत्तो
english: If it weren't for the cool breeze blowing through the clouds, You'd be ashamed to have missed the moon.

prakrit: पच्चूसगयवरुम्मूलियाए उड्डीणससिविहङ्गाए,रयणिलयाए गलन्तिव कुसुमाइं तारयनिहेण?
english: Are not emeralds like the jasmine flowers in a flock of parrots, Like the nectar of an emerald flower in a flying sapphire?

prakrit: अह इन्ददिसा सहसा केसुयसुयतुण्डसच्छहा जाया,आसन्नसूरमण्डलवज्जरणत्थंव लोयस्स
english: Ah! the dark sky is suddenly overcast with blue skies, Loose are the rays from the thundercloud that is approaching.

prakrit: पडिबोहियकमलवणो पसरियखरकिरणपूरियदियन्तो,मेलियरहङ्गजुयलो तदणन्तरमुग्गओ सूरो
english: The full moon is like the rays of a flicker of a rainbow, Like the jujube on a woman's thighs Which then sets in motion the sun.

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि अहयम्पि समुट्ठिऊण किच्चं पभायतणयं करिउं पयत्तो,भो सुप्पइट्ठ! तइया दइयाइ होही सन्दंसणम्ह इइ पहिट्ठमणो पगामं
english: Here I am, Sitting here for the night, Trying to figure out what to do next. Go to sleep! It's your mercy That keeps me from seeing you. This is the first step on my foot.

prakrit: एसोवि परिसमप्पइ विरहे सूरुग्गमॊत्ति सुपसिद्धो,सुरसुन्दरिनामाए कहाए तइओ परिच्छेओ ९५०
english: Aunt, It's past three o'clock And the sun is shining brightly. Tell me, my pretty girl, How long has it been Since you've had your period?

prakrit: अह भाओ भाणुवेगो समागओ पहसिओ ममं भणइ,गम्मउ उज्जाणम्मि चूयलयावयणमणुसरिउं
english: Oh! my brother! First you meet me, then you speak to me. Then I'll give you a bath in the steaming hot sun.

prakrit: हरिसाऊरियहियएण ताहि एवन्ति जपमाणेणं,तक्कालुचियं जाव य कायव्वं काउमारद्वं
english: If you want to enjoy nature, you have to chant it. If you like it, go and do it. It's because you love nature.

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि निसुओ मङ्गलतूरस्स गहिरनिग्घोसो,पुट्ठो य मए भाया कत्थ इमं वज्जए तूरं?
english: What do you mean by that? It's only a matter of a few minutes, You stupid fool, How can I explain it to you?

prakrit: तो भणइ भाणुवेगो सम्मं जाणे न कारणं एत्थ,नवरं अमियगइगिहे भाविज्जइ एस तूररवो
english: So he says,"" ""I don't know what to do with you, brother - in - law."" ""Now it's my turn to say goodbye.

english: Oh! why am I so anxious At the prospect of my beloved's return? For, my dear, Is it too early To tell which way to turn?

prakrit: ता भवियव्वं केणवि एत्थ नणु कारणेण ताहे मए,चूयलया वाहरिया समागया अह इमं भणिया
english: So what do you think? It's because I'm so naïve. Whether you ask me out or join in I'll tell you the truth.

english: How am I supposed to manage the distance, Foolish visitor, When someone's business is on the line? Tell me, I beg of you.

english: Destroyed chickpeas: The poor farmer has found a way out, But the lotus bud, pierced by a scorpion, Says so to me.

english: It's so windy here That I can't get in the way of the doormat. But don't let the crowd confuse me.

prakrit: तत्तो य बन्धुदत्तो पत्थुयवत्थुम्मि पुच्छिया भणइ,वरणम्मि एस भद्दे! महोच्छवो कणगमालाए
english: There you are, my friend, Asking how I'm feeling When you kiss my cheek. What a disgusting thing it is to touch a friend's cheek.

prakrit: सिरिगन्धवाहणसुओ गङ्गावत्तम्मि खयरनयरम्मि,नहवाहणॊत्ति सुम्मइ तस्स विइन्ना कणयमाला
english: The water of the Ganges flows smoothly, Like a river in spate, Like an earthenware pot in the middle of a stream.

prakrit: एवं वियाणिऊणं समागया एत्थ तुम्ह पासम्मि,कन्नकडुयम्पि तुम्हं साहिज्जइ मन्दाभागाए
english: And by the way, you're so close, my dear, That the twang in your ear Makes you look so miserable.

prakrit: तीए वयणं सोउं धसत्ति गुरुमोग्गरेण पहओ हं,मुच्छानिमीलियच्छो पडिओ भूमिए गयचेठ्ठो
english: She's so thin on her stomach That she is afraid of being angry with her master. But looking down at the ground she stumbles across a frown.

prakrit: घणसारसारगोसीसमीससलिलेण ताहि संसित्तो,सुकुमालतालविण्टयसीयलपवणेण गयमुच्छो
english: It's like having a lot of fun, Like making love with your lover, Like bathing in the lake of lotus.

prakrit: परिचिन्तिउं पयत्तो पेच्छह दुव्विहियविलासियं विहिणो,पियसङ्गमणोरहभंसणम्मि उज्जुत्तचित्तस्स
english: When you meet her you see that both of you are enjoying the luxury of marriage, That the passion for love is palpable And that her husband is happy.

prakrit: अहवा अन्नह परिचिन्तिज्जइ सहरिसकण्डुज्जएण हियएण,परिणमइ अन्नहच्चिय कज्जारम्भो विहिवसेण
english: Ahava anna is familiar to the townspeople through its thick, fragrant jasmine, Which in turn is distinguished from anna through its myriad occupations.

english: Katha, ima, katha, am I, and the like. All is lawless without food.

prakrit: पुव्वम्पि हु जइ बुद्धी एरिसया आसि तुज्झ रे दिव्व!,ता कह मह पढमं चिय तीए सह दंसणं विहियं?
english: If you are so clever, my dear, How can you be so clever? Tell me, dear girl, Why did you want to hang out with me?

prakrit: काऊम दंसणं गरूयरायसहियं हयास! रे! दिव्व!,अन्नत्थ तं मयच्छिं जोडेन्तो कि नं लज्जिहिसि?
english: How embarrassed I am To see my husband in such a state! Oh! Divine! Would you not be ashamed If you could join him on the pyre?

prakrit: अविय नयणाण पडउ वज्जं अहवा वज्जस्स वड्डिलं किम्पि,अमुणियजणेवि दिट्ठे अणुबन्धं जाणि कुव्वन्ति
english: Aviya nayan padau vajjanam ahava vajjassa vaddilam kimpi, The sight of innocent people makes one tremble at the thought of unbreakable bonds.

prakrit: खणपरिचियदुल्लहलोयकारणे कीस! तं मिहसि?,मुञ्चसु गरुयविसायं विवरीओ हयविही जेण
english: What do you mean you're angry? You're angry? It's because you're annoying me. I can't take it anymore.

prakrit: एरिसदुविस्सहेवि हु सञ्जाए हिययं गरुयदुक्खम्मि,वज्जघडियंव मन्ने जं नवि सयसिक्करं जासि
english: It is with great sadness that I acknowledge my mistake. The thunderclap signifies the arrival of a new master.

prakrit: एमाइबहुविगप्पं चिन्तेमाणस्स गरुयसोगस्स,तव्विरहदूमियमाणसस्स तइया महं कुमर!
english: What a fool you are, Thinking only of yourself, Like a man possessed by a demon!

prakrit: पुणरवि सा सोमलया समागया किञ्चि हरिसियाव मणे,उवविट्ठा मं दट्ठुं सुट्ठुं विसायाउरं तइया
english: Once again, my darling, Don't think I've anything to do with you: You look at me all the time, You stare at me with such longing.

prakrit: ता भणइ कीस सुन्दर! दीससि तं दुम्मणोव्व अच्चत्थं,सुणिउं वरणयवत्तं,ताव निसामेसु मह वयणं
english: How handsome you are! You look at that damned woman. Listen to her say the following:"" ""There must be something wrong with me.

prakrit: भणियं च मए अज्जवि किं आसा कावि अत्थि अम्हाण,वज्जरसि जेण एवं सोमलए!,ताहि सा भणइ
english: Tell me, brother - in - law, what do I have to say about you today, my dear?"" she mutters, ""You fool, you bastard!

prakrit: तुह विरहे गयचेट्ठं दट्ठूणं ताव कणगमालं तु,चूयलया कल्लम्मि पट्ठविया तुम्ह पासम्मि
english: You're so fragrant That you look at me with longing, You turn your back on me, Like a stone pierced by a needle.

prakrit: सावि हु सहीहिं कहवि तुह सङ्गमसूयगेहिं वयणेहिं,आसासियावि वरई तुह सङ्गमपावमाणा उ
english: I will tell you the truth,"" he said, ""By the pleasure of your company And not by false promises.

english: A poor girl wipes away tears, gets up again, turns on her hips, and sings, Laughs, or acts as if she's still asleep.

prakrit: गहगहिया इव बाला असमञ्जसचेट्ठियाइ कुणमाणा,हसियावि सहिजणेणं नवि जाणइ किञ्चि हयहियया
english: A proud girl, With eyes wide open And a smile on her face, Has no knowledge of what is to come.

prakrit: तं पेक्खिऊण य मए विचिन्तियं जाव मुयइ नो पाणे,गुरुअणुरागा एसा ताव उवायं विचिन्तेमि
english: I have no desire to see you again, Not because I am curious, But because I think of you in the same way As a teacher.

prakrit: तत्तो तव्वुत्तन्तो कहिओ गन्तूण चित्तमालाए,तज्जणणीए उ मए एगन्तगयाए सव्वोवि
english: So tell me, traveler, How long has it been since you last sang a song to me?

english: You silly girl, Why are you so forthright When there are lotuses all over the place? You fool, you fool! You fool?

prakrit: अच्छसि ओसन्नमुही भणियावि हु कीस देसि नालावं?,सुहसज्झं चेव इमं मा पुत्ति! विसायमुव्वहसु

english: My son, if you come with my senses, Why are you so anxious? Your senses will tell you what to do with your emotions.

english: That's the way it is."" ""Get up quickly, son! Don't let anyone fool you!

english: Come here and meet me at once, you wretched traveler; from now on no one will know how to travel.

english: When he asked her what she wanted to eat, She replied:"" ""It's my heart, My daughter - in - law; I give it all to him.

prakrit: तं सोउं अमियगई साममुहो तक्खणेण सञ्जाओ,भणइ अहो! अइगरूयं समागयं अम्ह वसणन्ति
english: That night I slept peacefully, But when he awoke I thought,"" ""We're going to sleep together.

prakrit: तो भणइ चित्तमाला पिययम! किं कारणं नु वसणस्स?,तत्तो य अमियगइणा वज्जरियं पिययमे! सुणसु
english: So tell me, Chittamala piyyam! Why don't you settle down? So, please, let me have a drink of this incomprehensible liquor! Listen up!

prakrit: नरवइकज्जेणेत्तो गङ्गावत्तम्मि तम्मि नयरम्मि,सिरिगन्धवाहणस्स ओ पासम्मि गओ अहं तइया
english: The stream of the Ganges swallows you in a fit of jealousy, O carrier of sweet smells, I have passed by You.

prakrit: कयविणओ उवविट्ठो अत्थाणगयस्स राइणो पासे,सम्भासिएण य तओ निवेइयं रायकज्जं से
english: Somehow you've got there By the side of a singing lion, And in conversation you must be talking to another rake.

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि सुन्दरि! पडिहारनिवेइओ अणुन्नाओ,अत्थाणम्मि पविट्ठो एगो विज्जाहरकुमारो
english: Here lies the beauty of mother - in - law! There lie the wonders of nature. At the very least the holy woman Is the wife of a wise man.

prakrit: विहियपणामो रन्नो पारद्धो एरिसं स वज्जरिउं,विज्जाहराण राया वेयड̣धे आसि जो देव!
english: Weeping and wailing, Are these the days of wisdom? The gods come only after we have spent the night in knowledge!

prakrit: संसिद्धसयलविज्जो ससुरासुरमणुयलोयविक्खाओ,सुरवाहणॊत्ति नामं विज्जाहरचक्कवट्टित्ति
english: In the name of the one who carries the jewel, The wheel of knowledge is turned upside down Like the bow of an old man.

prakrit: अवमाणवज्जियं जो विज्जाहररायलच्छिमणुहविउं,विक्खायजसं पुत्तं निययपए ठाविऊण तुमं
english: You dishonest son of a bitch, Who, for all intents and purposes, Pretends to be the youngest.

prakrit: संसारवासभीओ नाऊण असारयं विभूईए,रज्जसिरिं अवउज्झिय पडग्गलग्गं जरतणंव
english: Fear the world, For behold, I am bound to perish, For fear the strings of ropes That bend the rattle of a thunderclap.

prakrit: सिरिउसहनाहजिणवरवज्जरियं सव्वविरइरूवं जो,चारितं पडिवन्नो चित्तङ्गयमुणिवरसमीवे
english: Sirius, the thunderclap of victory is everywhere, Like the bow that falls four times in a row On the banks of the Chitangay.

prakrit: गहणा ' 'सेवणरूवं सिक्खं अब्भसिय गुरूसमीवम्मि,अहियसुओ पडिवज्जिय एगल्लविहारपडिमं सो
english: Jewels!"" cried the servant, ""And now at my master's feet I see a poor widow with loose hair.

prakrit: छट्ठ 'ट्ठमदसमदुवालसाइनाणाविहे तवोकम्मे,उज्जुत्तो विहरन्तो गामागरमण्डियं वसुहं
english: Chhath is here, Like a lotus on the moon, In the middle of the night, Brilliant as it were, Stretching across the village center.

prakrit: सम्पत्तो एत्थेव य वेयड̣धे चित्तकूडसिहरम्मि,तुम्ह पिया सुरवाहणविज्जाहरमुणिवरो अज्ज
english: Wealth alone is not enough, Weird man, Since your heart is heavy with desire, Today you will be my lover, Like a traveler's bow.

prakrit: पडिमापडिवन्नस्सिह सुक्कज्झाणेण खवियमोहस्स,लोयालोयपयासं उप्पन्नं केवलं तस्स
english: A wretched passion for pleasures based on flattery, Like the plowman's love, Exists only in him.

prakrit: तत्तो य तस्स वयणं सोऊणं गन्धवाहणो राया,हरिसवसवियसियच्छो भणइ तयं सायरं एवं
english: There you are, sniffing the scent of that fragrant fragrance From your mouth, Saying :'You must be sober '.

prakrit: भो आगच्छसु सङ्गय! आसन्नो,अज्ज तायवत्ताए,सहलीकयं म्ह जीयं केवलउप्पत्तिगब्माए
english: Come with me! Sit down! Today, mother - in - law, my life depends only on your loving - kindness.

prakrit: ससरीरपरिहियं सो सव्वं आभरणवत्थमाईयं,विलइय तस्स सरीरे तत्तो भण्डारियं भणइ
english: Everything outside the body is ornamental, but inside the body there is treasure.

prakrit: अद्धत्तेरसकोडी पवरसुवन्नस्स देसु एयस्स,पीईदाणं तत्तो तहत्ति सम्पाडियं तेण
english: Please, give me one hundred and fifty shekels of gold. There I can store all my wealth.

prakrit: तयणन्तरं च राया विज्जाहरनियरपरिगओ चलिओ,जणयस्स चित्तकूडे भत्तीए वन्दणनिमित्तं
english: After the arrow has passed, Raya walks across the wide aisle, To greet you with a loud clap of his hands.

prakrit: विज्जाविरइयवरविमाणआरूढपरियणाणुगओ,सुहनेवत्थविराइयनायरजणपरिगओ सहसा
english: A flight of fancy, A long flight of steps, A succession of pleasant and unusual people All at once.

prakrit: तेण सहिओ अहम्पि हु चलिओ मुणिपायवन्दणनिमित्तं,अह सव्वे सम्पत्ता आसन्ने चित्तकूडस्स
english: With that, my friend, I am ready to depart on account of the pleasantries offered. All this wealth is for the good of my heart.

prakrit: चउविहदेवनिकायं निवयन्तं दट्ठुं चित्तकूडम्मि,सविसेसहरिसियमणो वियसियमुहपङ्कओ राया
english: Seeing the four divine beings face to face, Keeping one's mind open, One cannot help feeling uneasy When one is surrounded by relatives.

prakrit: सिग्घतरं गन्तूणं बहुजणपरिवारिओ पयत्तेण,सुरकयकेवलिमहिमं थुव्वन्तं दिव्वनारीहिं
english: The happier the destination, The more likely it is that many families will visit; The sweeter the lamp, The thinner its fragrance.

prakrit: दट्ठूण मुणिवरं तं काऊण पयाहिणं च तिक्खुत्तो,बहुमाणवससमुट्ठियरोमञ्चयञ्चियसरीरो
english: The sharp arrow pierces the bow at the sight of the sage And the crow at the pyre, Like a panorama of many human settlements.

prakrit: भूमितललुलियमउडं पञ्चङ्गं करिय ताहे पणिवायं,पहरिसगलन्तनयणो अह एवं थुणिउमाढत्तो
english: The lotus of the earth looks like a panchang of acacia flowers, Like the tip of a spittle stuck in a snake's eye.

prakrit: जय जय जीवदयावर! सुक्कज्झाणेणदड्ढकम्मवण!,वोच्छिन्नभवनिबन्धण! जाइजरामरणदुक्खहर!
english: Jai jai, Jivadayavar! The rapture of the joys and sorrows! The dissolution of the ties of karma! The resurrection of the living!

prakrit: उप्पन्नविमलकेवलउवलद्धसमत्थणेयसब्भाव!,सासयसिवसुहसाहण! पत्तअहक्खायचारित्त!
english: Loud clapping of the hands, Loud cheering, Lovely laugh! It's just the nature of love!

prakrit: भयवं अणाइनिहणे परिब्भमन्ताण भवसमुद्दम्मि,दाउं हत्थालम्बं अम्ह समुत्तारणं कुणसु ७१
english: Fear has overtaken me, And my heart is aflame with ecstasy. Right now, at the tips of my hands, I must answer you,"" 71

prakrit: एवं थुणिऊण मुणिं मुणिमुहकमलनिहियमणनयणो,उवविट्ठो धरणीए नासन्ने नाइदूरम्मि
english: And do not look down at the lotus Placed in front of you As if it were a spittle, For there is nothing farther from the earth Than this.

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि मुणिणा परत्थसम्पायणेक्करसिएण,गम्भीरभारईए पारद्धा देसणा एवं
english: Here and there the bow is bowed, The pledge is made, The burden is great, And the path is arduous.

prakrit: अइदुलहं मणुयत्तं असासंसारसागरगयाणं,कुगईण पउरभावा सकम्मवसगाण जीवाणं
english: I am only human, Singing the ocean of non - existence, Living the song of virtue and virtue.

prakrit: तम्पि हु जराभिभूयं आवासो रोगसोगवाहीणं,सारीरमाणसाणेयदुक्खसम्पायकलियन्ति
english: My brother, I am so thin and wretched, And suffer from illness, That I gather sorrow from all my feelings.

prakrit: पवणाहयधयवडचञ्चलाओ लच्छीओ तहय मणुयाणं,अणवट्ठिया य नेहा सुहिसयमपियाइजणविसया
english: There are clouds hovering over the horizon, People looking on, People sitting idle, And women making love While making love.

prakrit: विसयसुहम्पि हु परिणामदारूणं नारयाइदुहहेऊ,आरम्भपरिग्गहसञ्चियस्स पावस्स परिणामो
english: With long sighs I yield fruit, But with short bursts of laughter The consequences of sin Are twofold.

prakrit: अइभीसणेण बन्धेण गरूयपीडावहो खु जीवाणं,मिच्छावियप्पवसओ सव्वम्पि हु सोक्खमाभाइ
english: I am content with living my life in poverty, bound by selfishness, But I am completely content with what I have done wrong.

prakrit: अणवरयसम्पयट्टो मच्चू अवहरइ जीवसङ्घायं,एवं च ठिए भो भो भद्दा! सम्मं विचिन्तेह
english: The unattainable treasure of pearls Endures all life, And still you look on in amazement!

prakrit: केवलिभणियं धम्मं मोत्तूणं नत्थि किञ्चि अन्नन्ति,सरणं भवभीयाणं भवियाणं भवनिबुड्डाणं
english: Only those who believe in Dharma, Who do not believe in anything, Fear the divine, For those who fear the divine are bound by the divine.

prakrit: तम्हा कुणह पयत्तं दुलहं लद्धूण माणुसं जम्मं,जिणइन्दभणियधम्मे सासयसिवसोक्खहेउम्मि
english: For all your virtues, Being a good husband and a good man is the supreme happiness.

prakrit: सावज्जकज्जवज्जणरूवं परिगेण्हिऊण पव्वज्जं,खविऊण कम्मसत्तुं सासयसोक्खं वयह मोक्खं
english: Freedom is attained through circumspection, through penance, through sacrifice, through compassion, through sincere devotion to duty.

prakrit: इय केवलिणा भणिए विणिवेसिय करयलञ्जलिं सीसे,वज्जरइ गन्धवाहणराया उ तहत्ति जं भणह
english: It's only a girl who says:"" ""Stop wasting your time making love,"" ""But when you tell her you're not, She sniffs at everything you say.

prakrit: दाउं विज्जानियरं रज्जेण समं तु निययपुत्तस्स,नहवाणस्स तत्तो करोमि गिहवासचायन्ति
english: You are as good a teacher as any of the wise; I will instruct you in every way.

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि सुन्दरि! पत्थावं जाणिऊण पुच्छाए,विहियपणामेण मए पुट्ठो मुणिकेवली एवं
english: Here's that lovely girl! If you ask her how she knows the path, She'll tell you it's the mud of the mud.

prakrit: लोयालोयविलोयणकेवलनाणेण नायभावस्स,पच्चक्खं हि भयवओ एयं जमहं तु पुच्छिस्सं
english: Don't be so naïve, you fool, Loyalist. Yet, for fear of being caught, I am asking you all the same.

prakrit: एक्कच्चिय मह धूया जाया विन्नाणरूवसम्पुन्ना,पाणाणवि वल्लहिया नामेणं कणगमालत्ति
english: One day I'll wash away the pollen From the wilting arrows That stick to my cheeks. The waterman's wife calls me by the name of Vallahya.

prakrit: धूयाए को भत्ता होही मणवल्लहॊत्ति एयाए,चिन्ताए मह हिययं भयवं! निच्चपि अक्खलियं
english: Allow the washerman to wash my clothes. It's like washing a man's hair. Worry about it. It scares me! I'm still speechless.

prakrit: ता मणनिव्वुइहेउं साहिज्जउ एस अम्ह वुत्तन्तो,पाणिग्गहणं तीए को किर विज्जाहरो काही?
english: Tell me, my dear,"" she said, as I approached her. ""Is there anything you want to tell me about your husband?

prakrit: एवं च पुच्छिएणं केवलिणा सुयणु! एरिसं भणियं,मा भद्द! कुण विसायं थोव चिय एत्थ वत्थुम्मि
english: And only ask how old she is! I'll tell you this. Don't be silly! Put on some clothes. That's what I'm talking about.

prakrit: तुह धूयाए भत्ता सो होही जो इमम्मि वेयड̣धे,गुणकलियं पालिस्सइ विज्जाहरचक्कवट्टित्तं
english: The allowance that washes away from you is the same as that given to me by my wife, Who polishes the virtues with the help of a brilliant wheel.

prakrit: पुव्वभवनेहबद्धा तुह धूया तस्स पाणवल्लहिया,होही सयलन्तेउरललामभूया महादेवी
english: Poor Bhavane, The only thing that washes you clean is water from the well, That is, The lotus flower Mahadevi standing in a straight line.

prakrit: केवलिवयणं सोउं सञ्जाओ मज्झ गरूयआणन्दो,एत्थन्तरम्मि राया समुट्ठिओ वन्दिऊण मुणिं
english: Only in poetry do I conceal my pride, For here on earth the whole body of Raya is covered with gooseflesh.

prakrit: तत्तो रन्ना सहिओ समागओ तम्मि चेव नयरम्मि,अह रन्ना हं भणिओ बहुमाणजुयं इमं वयणं
english: There was a lot of running around, And the roads were slippery all the time. So I said,"" ""Run, boy, is that the way it should be For many young men?

prakrit: अइवल्लहावि धूया दायव्वा ताव कस्सइ नरस्स,जं एसा लोगट्ठिई तेणम्हे एरिसं भणिमो
english: What do you mean, poor girl, You're a coward? That's what I meant when I said,"" ""There are people like that out there.

prakrit: नहवाहणस्स दिज्जउ सा कन्ना जेण वित्तवीवाहं,निययपए ठविउणं सेवामो तायपयजुयलं
english: Give me a bath And I'll take care of you. For as long as I have money, Service given me by appointment Is bound to pay.

prakrit: तत्तो मएवि भणियं एत्थत्थे नत्थि किञ्चि वत्तव्वं,धूया कित्तियमेत्तं पाणावि हु तुम्ह आयत्ता
english: That's my sister - in - law's name. Don't talk to her about it. How much water do you need to wash yourself?

prakrit: सच्चिय धूया धन्ना सुण्हा जा होइ देवपायाणं,केवलिगिरावि सच्चा जं किज्जइ एरिसे विहिए
english: Truth alone triumphs, fortune alone vanishes, Devapayana alone prevails, But true wisdom resides in whatever one does.

prakrit: तुम्ह सुयं मोत्तूणं वेयड्ढगिरिम्मि होज्ज को अन्नो,विज्जाण चक्कवट्टी जस्स पिया होज्ज मह धूया?
english: Are you the kind of person who likes to lie on your back And be nasty to others? One way of putting it is by saying,"" ""I'm drunk.

prakrit: एवं च मए भणिए वियसियवयणेण राइणाणत्तो,सोमजसो जोइसिओ विवाहलग्गं निरूवेसु
english: And I said:"" ""Vyasavyavayana raina natu, so please, Mr. King, untie the marriage knot.

prakrit: तत्तो जोइसिएणं सम्मं आलोचिऊण आइट्ठं,वइसाहसुद्धपञ्चमिरत्तीए सोहणं लग्गं
english: Come, think of it while you're busy making love. For the good wife wants to be bound to her lover's bow.

prakrit: तत्तो य मए भणियं आएसं देह जेण गन्तूण,नियनयरेसञ्जुत्तिं विवाहकज्जस्स कारेमि
english: Then, my dear, As my body is about to depart, I will arrange for you to be married according to your wishes.

prakrit: तेणाणुन्नाओ हं सिग्घं चिय आगओ इहं सुयणु!,रायामच्चेहिं समं चन्दजसा ' 'इच्चनामेहिं
english: There goes the fire That burns so long, Like the rays of the moon In a dream.

prakrit: एएवि कणगमालावरणत्थं आगया मए समयं,कल्ले पभायसमए किल होइ वरणयं तीए
english: Aavi kanagamala ambarthanam means"" ""My time is fire, Tomorrow at dawn I will be killed"" ""and so on.

prakrit: एवं च ठिए एसा एक्का धूया सुट्ठु पिया ताव कणगमालम्ह,एईए अणुराओ सञ्जाओ चित्तवेगम्मि
english: And just like that, One washes, Soothes, and drinks the bitter nectar. It makes one feel good.

prakrit: ता जइ मणो 'णुकूलं सम्पाडिस्सं न एक्कधूयाए,एईयवि,ता सुन्दरी! किञ्च मए जीविएणन्ति?
english: If that man's wealth cannot be put together, That woman is beautiful! How can I live without him?

prakrit: उवयारेणं महया विमग्गिया राइणा सुयनिमित्तं,सिरिगन्धवाहणेणं मएवि दिन्ना इमा तस्स
english: Uvayarennen mahaya vimaggiya raina suyyake, Sirigandha vahanennen mevi dinna ima tasa.

prakrit: तं च इयाणिं अन्नहकाउं चाइज्जए न जं सुयणु!,एएण कारणेणं मे भणियं आगयं वसणं
english: I don't want to go to bed hungry! That's why I have to settle here tomorrow.

prakrit: एवं पिययमवयणं सोऊणं चित्तवेग! सञ्जाया,मह सामिणीवि विच्छायवयणिया चित्तमालत्ति
english: And the desire to sleep when one is drunk! My good wife, Sanjaya, is always distracted by distractions.

prakrit: तत्तो तीए भणियं मह चित्ते फुरइ एरिसं ताव,परिचयइ कणगमाला तव्विरहे जीवियमवस्सं
english: There she is, Sitting beside me, Making my heart swell with joy, Introducing me to the joys of being alive.

prakrit: कहकहवि मए जं सा तप्पावणसुयगेहिं वयणेहिं,पुव्विं सधीरविया एयं पुण अन्नहा जायं
english: Tell me, my dear, How can I escape, If only I had the strength To go on like this?

prakrit: भणियं च अमियगइणा एवं हि ठिए करेमि किं सुयणु!,जइ ताव न देमि इमं तो राया रूसइ अवस्सं
english: My brother and I are incompetent, so why should I sleep? If I don't give it to you, Raya will get angry.

prakrit: केवलिवयणा रन्नो अइगरुओ एत्थ आयरो जाओ,तेण इमाइ अदाणे अइगरुयं होइ मह खूणं
english: Only the poor widow can make a fool of herself, So let her go and steal my present.
